Job Description

Title: Program Manager

Location: Sydney/Melbourne, Australia

Type: Full Time - Hybrid

SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

SS&C GIDS provides information processing and computer software services and products. The Company’s operating segments include financial markets, customer management, professional services, and output solutions. SS&C GIDS serves the alternative investments, asset and wealth management, banking and lending, insurance, and real estate industries.

What You Will Get to Do:

As a Program Manager, you will lead the delivery and governance of the IFL Portfolio, focusing on the BAU Charge Portfolio and overseeing the assessment of impacts to strategic initiatives, including the Indigo program. You will provide end-to-end portfolio leadership, ensuring initiatives are aligned to business strategy, delivery priorities, governance standards, and expected business outcomes.

Working closely with senior business leaders, product owners, delivery teams, and key stakeholders, you will establish robust governance practices, manage cross-program dependencies, drive benefits realisation, and provide executive-level visibility into portfolio performance.

You will play a critical role in ensuring delivery momentum is maintained across a complex portfolio of initiatives while proactively managing risks, issues, resource constraints, and competing priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end management and governance of the IFL Portfolio, ensuring initiatives remain aligned with strategic business objectives and organisational priorities.
  • Establish and maintain portfolio governance frameworks, reporting standards, decision-making forums, and delivery controls.
  • Provide portfolio oversight across multiple concurrent projects and programs, ensuring effective prioritisation, sequencing, and delivery coordination.
  • Drive benefits realisation management, ensuring business outcomes are defined, tracked, measured, and reported throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Monitor portfolio performance against agreed milestones, outcomes, risks, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Identify, manage, and resolve cross-program dependencies, ensuring delivery activities are effectively coordinated across teams and business units.
  • Lead portfolio planning activities, including roadmap development, delivery forecasting, resource planning, and strategic prioritisation.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with executive stakeholders, providing trusted advice, decision support, escalation management, and strategic recommendations.
  • Facilitate Steering Committees, governance forums, and executive reporting processes, ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of progress, risks, and decisions required.
  • Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations, and Business leaders to align priorities and support successful delivery outcomes.
  • Drive proactive risk and issue management across the portfolio, ensuring mitigation strategies are implemented and monitored.
  • Support delivery teams by establishing clear governance, removing impediments, and enabling successful execution.
  • Champion continuous improvement across program and project delivery practices, leveraging lessons learned and industry best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with internal governance frameworks, regulatory obligations, audit requirements, and organisational standards.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and delivery excellence across the portfolio.
  • Lead post-implementation reviews and outcome assessments to ensure expected value and business benefits have been achieved.

What You Will Bring

  • 8+ years' experience delivering complex programs, portfolios, or large-scale strategic change initiatives within Financial Services, Superannuation, Wealth Management, Transfer Agency, Investments, or Software Delivery environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple related projects and programs within a portfolio environment.
  • Strong understanding of portfolio, program, and project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
  • Proven ability to establish and operate effective governance, reporting, and decision-making frameworks.
  • Experience managing senior executive stakeholders and influencing outcomes across multiple business functions.
  • Strong commercial and financial management capability, including business case oversight, benefits realisation, forecasting, budgeting, and investment governance.
  • Expertise in risk, dependency, issue, and change management across complex delivery environments.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong leadership capability with experience leading cross-functional teams and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery leadership.
  • Highly organised, outcome-focused, and capable of managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience using portfolio and project management tooling including Jira, Confluence, and other delivery management platforms.
  • Relevant qualifications in Program Management, Project Management, Agile Delivery, or related disciplines (PgMP, MSP, PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe or equivalent highly regarded).

Why This Role Matters

The IFL Portfolio is a strategically important delivery portfolio consisting of multiple interdependent initiatives that require strong governance, coordinated execution, executive stakeholder engagement, and disciplined benefits realisation. The Program Manager will provide the leadership and oversight necessary to maximise business value, proactively manage risks and dependencies, optimise resource utilisation, and ensure successful delivery of key strategic outcomes.

This role serves as the central point of accountability for portfolio performance, enabling delivery teams to remain focused on execution while ensuring program-level planning, governance, stakeholder management, and value realisation are effectively managed.

title: C Lineman - Overhead (Dominion)
description:
Position Summary

The Class C Lineman is an entry level line work position to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Help install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Two (2) years of relevant field experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

title: Certified Recovery Mentor (Integrated Team Based Care))
description:
Certified Recovery Mentor (Integrated Team Based Care))

Job Overview

Location/Schedule: This position is based within the urgent walk-in clinic at our Garlington Health Center, located in NE Portland, OR. The schedule for this position is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Position: Certified Recovery Mentor (CRM)

Program: Integrated team Based Care (ITBC)

Cascadia’s Mission and Vision:

Mission: Cascadia Health delivers whole health care – integrated mental health and addiction services, primary care, and housing – to promote hope and support the well-being of the communities we serve.

Vision: We envision a community where everyone benefits from whole health care, experiences well-being, and has a self-directed, connected life.

Position Description: The Certified Recovery Mentor (CRM) will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team to provide peer recovery support to individuals with substance abuse and mental health disorders. This position will advocate for the Individuals We Serve (IWS) and support them to pursue their personal goals and individual wellness journey.

The job incumbent must understand, appreciate, and respect the differences within our Cascadia community. As such, it is expected that this position promotes integrated care, our vision of trauma-informed and person-first approaches and helps create a work environment of acceptance.

Essential Responsibilities

This position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, or working conditions associated with the position. Management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties as necessary.

General

  • Participate in clinical case conferences and staff meetings to enhance knowledge, align with program goals, and advocate for individual needs.

  • Serve as an advocate within the organization and with external partners or service providers.

  • Demonstrate a recovery‑focused and healthy lifestyle.

  • Share personal recovery experiences with IWS when appropriate and supportive.

  • Ensure that the needs and voices of IWS being served are represented.

  • Link IWS to various recovery support models and community resources.

  • Assist IWS in developing a strong, sustainable support network.

  • Provide guidance on accessing and navigating community systems such as recovery communities, housing resources, and public transportation.

  • Apply Feedback Informed Treatment (FIT) practices as part of service delivery team and in alignment with Cascadia and program’s current level of FIT implementation.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Regulatory & Compliance

  • Comply with and implement regulations, policies, and procedures under which the department and program operate.

  • Assist in crisis situations as appropriate, following emergency protocols and procedures.

  • Understand fire regulations and evacuation procedures; participate in regular safety drills in compliance with department policies and procedures.

  • Document and maintain records in a manner that ensures compliance with all agency policies and procedures and local, state, and federal regulations.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation as required and complete electronic medical records (EMR) as required using Cascadia software.

  • Adhere to mandatory abuse reporting laws, HIPAA and 42CFR regulations requirements.

  • Complete annual employee training requirements on a timely basis.

  • Participate in all scheduled staff meetings, supervision sessions, and other departmental and agency meetings.

Qualifications

Education:

Required:

  • A completed Recovery Mentor training approved by the Oregon Health Authority (OHA).

  • A Traditional Healthcare Worker (THW) certification which must be kept current and in compliance with the OAR’s.

Experience:

Required:

  • Position requires experience as a former or current user of behavioral health services.

  • Must self-disclose as being in active recovery from substance addiction and must have personal experience with recovery services.

Preferred:

  • Some work experience working with adults with substance abuse challenges.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Effective communication and active listening skills.

  • Demonstrated effective interpersonal and customer service skills.

  • Ability to demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and initiative in daily work activities

  • Knowledge of professional standards, ethical conduct, and accountability expectations in a healthcare environment.

  • Understanding of principles related to person‑centered care, safety, and well‑being.

  • Ability to work proactively and effectively in a team as well as independently.

  • Operate computer hardware and software at a level needed to effectively perform job functions.

Other:

  • Possess a valid driver’s license, one-year driving history, clean driving record, ability to pass Driver Motor Vehicle (DMV) check and complete the Cascadia online Defensive Driving course.

  • Must have the ability to perform CPR and properly use AED equipment. BLS certification training will be provided within the first 60 days of hire for client-facing staff, and CPR certification training will be provided within 120 days for all other staff. Certification must remain current.

Working Conditions

Environmental: This role is centered on direct IWS and community engagement, it is designed for in-person work and does not include hybrid or remote work options. Work is performed in one or more of the following: administrative office, clinical office, acute care settings and community setting including IWS residences, correctional facilities, shelters, hospitals, public places and other social service sites. Meal periods and breaks are subject to interruption. Universal Precautions and remaining alert to the environment are critical to address the potential for aggressive behavior, exposure to disease, biohazards, noise, and contaminants.

Mental Demands: The work assigned is diverse and involves addressing new and unusual circumstances. The work regularly involves a degree of unpredictability and disruption of planned tasks requiring a flexible time management approach. In addition, this position requires exercising sound judgment.

  • Regular social activities, from monthly team lunches to annual company-wide events

title: Verifiointitiimin tuottaja, Tutkiva+, Yle Uutiset
description:
Elämme aikaa, jossa kuvat valehtelevat ja disinformaatio leviää. Yleisö tarvitsee luotettavaa, faktoihin pohjautuvaa, mutta kiinnostavasti paketoitua journalismia enemmän kuin koskaan.

Tule tekemään ainutlaatuista työtä ja varmistamaan, että suomalaiset tietävät, mihin luottaa.

Mitä on luvassa?

Verifiointitiimi tekee Suomessa poikkeuksellista työtä visuaalisessa tiedonhankinnassa ja disinformaation paljastamisessa. Tiimi auttaa yleisöä ymmärtämään, miten digitaalinen vaikuttaminen toimii.

Tiimin tuottajana tehtäväsi on huolehtia, että tartutte olennaisiin aiheisiiin kunnianhimoisella tavalla. Ideoit, editoit ja autat tiimiä onnistumaan.

Työhön kuuluu sekä nopeaa uutisreagointia että syvälle kaivautuvaa tutkivaa journalismia, aihekirjo on laaja. Tiimi julkaisee visuaalisesti näyttävää verkkojournalismia ja uutisia kaikissa Ylen välineissä - yhteistyössä Yle Svenskan kanssa myös ruotsiksi.

Verifiointitiimi kuuluu uutisten Tutkivaplus-toimitukseen ja tekee yhteistyötä myös Ylen muiden toimitusten kanssa. Työtä tehdään Pasilassa, pääosan viikosta läsnä.

Tänä syksynä tiimi kasvaa, haemme parhaillaan myös uusia verifioijia: Toimittajahaku

Tuottajan esihenkilö on Tutkivaplussan toimituspäällikkö.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja alkaa 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Olet kokenut ja laaja-alainen journalisti, joka ymmärtää, missä aiheissa verifiointia erityisesti tarvitaan. Hallitset itsekin verifioinnin perustyökalut ja visuaaliset tiedonlähteet. Ymmärrät, mitä tiedonhankinnan ja kerronnan keinoja eri tilanteissa on syytä käyttää.

Et pelkää teknologista murrosta, vaan näet sen mahdollisuutena luoda uutta. Innostut tekoälystä arjen apuna, mutta ymmärrät myös AI:n riskit.

Olet tiimiä innostava työnjohtaja, joka auttaa muita loistamaan ja haluaa myös oppia itse uutta.

Journalismin etiikka on selkärangassasi. Kestät kiireistenkin uutistilanteiden paineet.

Miksi meille?

Yle on Suomen luotetuin media. Meillä pääset tekemään merkityksellistä, näkyvää ja vaikuttavaa journalismia suurille yleisöille. Sinulla on suoraa valtaa vaikuttaa siihen, mistä suomalaiset puhuvat ja mihin he voivat luottaa.

Verifiointitiimissä ympärilläsi on tiedonhankinnan terävin kärki.

Meillä saat olla oma itsesi työyhteisössä, jossa toisia autetaan, arvostetaan ja innostetaan ylittämään itsensä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hyvä! Hae tehtävää ja liitä mukaan CV:si ja hakemuskirjeesi viimeistään 2.9.2026.

title: Kaksi journalistia verifiointitiimiin, Tutkiva+, Yle Uutiset
description:
Kun valtarakenteet vavahtelevat ja tekoäly muuttaa maailmaa, totuutta haastetaan kovempaa kuin koskaan ennen. Ylen verifiointitiimi on tärkeä osa Ylen luotettavaa uutishankintaa nopeissa uutisissa ja syventävässä tiedonkaivuussa.

Mitä on luvassa?

Tutkit, varmistat ja analysoit erilaisia informaatiolähteitä ja teet esimerkiksi visuaalista tiedonhankintaa hyödyntäviä uutissisältöjä yleisölle. Autat suomalaisia ymmärtämään, miten digitaalinen vaikuttaminen toimii. Juttujasi julkaistaan Ylen eri alustoilla, verkosta uutislähetyksiin.

Verifiointitiimi tekee laajaa yhteistyötä sekä Ylen sisällä että ulkopuolella. Pääset työskentelemään laajasti journalismin eri aiheiden parissa kiireisistä uutistilanteista syventävään journalismiin. Työmme ytimessä on jatkuva uuden oppiminen. Kehitämme työtapojamme aktiivisesti.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Huipputiimissämme tarvitsemme paljon erilaista osaamista, kuten kykyä tunnistaa syväväärennöksiä ja tutkia erilaisia visuaalisia lähteitä, kykyä hyödyntää avoimia lähteitä, ymmärtää tekoälyn ja sosiaalisen median alustojen logiikkaa.

Nyt vahvistamme tiimiä uusilla osaajilla. Sinulla on vahva palo oppia uutta ja hypätä pois mukavuusalueelta. Voit tulla tehtävään useasta eri taustasta, mutta sinulla pitää olla tuntemus journalismista ja sen vaatimuksista. Olet rohkea, yhteistyökykyinen ja muuntautumiskykyinen. Tekemisen tavat muuttuvat jatkuvasti, joten hyvä asenne on kaiken perusta.

Voit olla toimittaja, joka on jo tehnyt journalismia hyödyntäen avoimia tietolähteitä. Erityisosaamisesi voi olla ohjelmointia, paikkatiedon hyödyntämistä tai esimerkiksi kykyä tutkia tehokkaasti laajoja sosiaalisen median aineistoja. Jos tuot tiimiimme vahvaa substanssiosaamista (esim. tekoäly, sodat ja konfliktit, asejärjestelmät tai finanssiala) tai vaikka uuden kielitaidon, olemme iloisia.

Ymmärrät dataa ja osaat tutkia kuvia ja videoita, vähintäänkin olet erittäin kiinnostunut niistä ja innokas oppimaan uutta. Osaat lisäksi paketoida juttusi kiinnostavaan muotoon, jossa visuaalisuudella on iso rooli.

Voit olla myös visuaalinen osaaja, joka taitaa monet ilmaisumuodot. Verifiointitiimin jutuissa näytämme sen, mitä olemme tutkineet. Osaat tai olet kiinnostunut oppimaan esimerkiksi geopaikannusta tai kuvaväärennöksien tulkintaa.

Yksi tärkeistä ilmaisumuodoistamme on video. Voit olla videojournalisti, jolle myös sosiaalisen median ilmaisumuodot ovat tuttuja. Yhdistät työssäsi sujuvasti eri välineisiin sopivan tarinankerronnan, leikkaamisen ja animoinnin.

Vahvuutesi tiedonhankinnassa on visuaalinen ymmärryksesi, ja voit tuoda tiimiimme esimerkiksi taitosi animoinnissa ja 3D-mallintamisessa. Sinulla on laaja tuntemus eri visuaalisista lähteistä.

Miksi meille?

Meillä pääset tekemään merkityksellistä, näkyvää ja vaikuttavaa journalismia suurille yleisöille verkkoon, televisioon ja radioon. Sinulla on valtaa vaikuttaa siihen, mihin suomalaiset luottavat ja mistä puhuvat.

Verifiointitiimi on osa uutisten Tutkivaplus-toimitusta, joka koostuu monipuolisista journalismin ammattilaisista. Tiimi pystyy tekemään sisältöjä sekä suomeksi että ruotsiksi, yhteistyössä Yle Svenskan kanssa.

Verifiointitiimin juttuja voit käydä lukemassa täältä: https://haku.yle.fi/?page=1&query=verifiointi

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan tai 1.10.2026. Tiimi työskentelee Pasilan uutistoimituksessa pääosin läsnätyössä.

Haemme samalla tiimiin myös vakituista tuottajaa. Hakuilmoituksen löydät täältä: Tuottajahaku

Kiinnostuitko?

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä oheinen hakemus viimeistään keskiviikkona 2.9.2026. Liitä mukaan cv:si, hakemuskirjeesi ja työnäyte, joka avaa erityisosaamistasi. Kerro hakemuksessa, miten juuri sinun osaamisesi täydentäisi verifiointitiimiä.

Jos haluat lisätietoja tai jäit pohtimaan, olisiko tämä sinun paikkasi, ota rohkeasti yhteyttä.

title: Assistant Vice President, Post Trade Business Implementation & Analytics
description:
Company Introduction:

We’re home to Asia's most dynamic and vibrant capital markets.
Connecting capital, ideas, inspiration and innovation for deeper, more diverse and liquid global capital markets; providing greater choice and opportunity for our customers, each and every day.

HKEX is a purpose-driven company. Our commitment to the long-term development of our business and our markets is articulated in our purpose: "To Connect, Promote and Progress our Markets and the Communities they support for the prosperity of all."

Job Summary:

We are seeking a high-calibre Business Analyst to join the Post Trade Business Implementation & Analytics Team under HKEX's Operations Division. The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation and enhancement of HKEX's risk management platforms, including Value-at-Risk (VaR) initiatives and other strategic post-trade transformation programmes.

This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, quantitative risk teams, IT development teams, and external vendors to translate business needs into effective system solutions. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of HKEX's risk infrastructure and support critical market risk management functions.

Job Duties:

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead business analysis activities for risk management and VaR platform implementation projects.

  • Engage with business users, risk management teams, operations teams, and other stakeholders to understand, analyze, and document high quality business requirements, prepare process flows and other project deliverables.

  • Collaborate with IT teams, quantitative risk teams and third-party vendors to evaluate solution options, review solution designs, functional specifications, and technical documentation to ensure requirements are accurately captured and traceable throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Facilitate workshops and requirement discussions to ensure alignment between business objectives and technology solutions.

  • Support impact assessments, gap analyses, and feasibility studies for new risk methodologies, regulatory changes, and platform enhancements.

  • Work closely with project managers and development teams to manage requirements, scope, dependencies, risks, and change requests.

  • Develop and execute UAT strategies and test scenarios.

  • Support project delivery from initiation through implementation, ensuring milestones are delivered on schedule and meet business expectations.

Key Requirements

  • University degree in Risk Management, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related disciplines.

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within financial market infrastructure, exchanges, clearing houses, banks, or risk management environments.

  • Experience delivering large-scale system implementation projects involving risk management, margining, VaR, pricing, or post-trade systems.

  • Solid understanding of market risk concepts, including Value-at-Risk (VaR), margin methodologies, stress testing, or derivatives products. Knowledge of clearing and post-trade operations is an advantage.

  • Strong experience in requirements gathering, business process modelling, functional analysis, and solution design.

  • Proven ability to work effectively with both business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technology solutions.

  • Familiarity with SDLC, Agile delivery methodologies, and project management tools such as JIRA and Confluence.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Experience with SQL, Python, data analysis tools, or reporting solutions is preferred.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Self-motivated team player with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple initiatives concurrently.

  • Experience in exchange, clearing, risk management, or regulatory environments will be highly regarded.

HKEX is committed as an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values and we look to support, respect diverse perspectives, abilities, culture and experiences within our workplace.

Location:

HKEX - Exchange Square

Shift:

Standard - 40 Hours (Hong Kong SAR)

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Worker Type:

Permanent

title: eCommerce Site Experience Lead
description:
Help Shape the Future of Modern Mobility

Role Overview

This role sits at the center of Travelpro's transformation—from a trusted legacy brand into a design-led, consumer-obsessed modern mobility company.


The DTC Consumer Experience Partner is directly responsible for optimizing the user interface, visual design, and navigational structure of Travelpro's digital storefronts globally — driving measurable improvements in engagement, product discoverability, and conversion rate. This role owns all front-end site elements including homepage layouts, product detail pages, collection pages, and landing pages, with a relentless focus on reducing friction and increasing the efficiency of the purchase path. AI-native execution is expected: this role uses generative tools and agent workflows to ship faster and test more.


Serving as the primary liaison between Creative, Product, and Marketing teams, this role translates merchandising strategies and campaign priorities into data-informed, conversion-oriented digital experiences. Success is measured by meaningful improvement in bounce rate, conversion rate, and click-through performance across key site paths.


What You’ll Do

Site Experience & Front-End Strategy

  • Lead and implement front-end experience strategy across the site — homepage, navigation, collection pages, landing pages, PDPs, and cart
  • Manage homepage layout and strategy in collaboration with the DTC lead to ensure seasonal and promotional goals are reflected in site content
  • Own collection page layouts, filters, and visual disruptors, using tools like Nosto to support merchandising logic and elevate key categories
  • Develop new landing pages for campaigns, seasonality, and product storytelling, ensuring alignment with broader marketing goals
  • Manage and optimize global shopping experiences across Shop App, Facebook Shop, Instagram Shop, TikTok Shop, and emerging surfaces

Product Detail Pages & Content

  • Build and refresh PDPs for new product launches and bundles, integrating video, imagery, and feature callouts that enhance product understanding and conversion
  • Partner with the Creative and Product Marketing teams to align on photography, video, copy, and overall content strategy
  • Manage and maintain the on-site blog in collaboration with SEM and content teams, optimizing copy to improve SEO performance and organic visibility

Testing, Analytics & Optimization

  • Lead A/B and qualitative user testing initiatives to identify friction points and continuously improve site flow, content hierarchy, and design elements
  • Monitor site interaction to guide UX enhancements
  • Stay current on eCommerce trends, technologies, and UX patterns to ensure Travelpro's site remains best-in-class in functionality and design
  • Use LLMs and AI design tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Figma AI, V0, Cursor) for hypothesis generation, copy variants, template mockups, creative iteration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the Commercial/Planning and DTC leads to translate promotional strategies and product priorities into elevated visual experiences that drive revenue and conversion
  • Work daily with Creative, Merchandising, Retention, and Performance Marketing to ensure cohesive execution across all digital touchpoints

What It Takes (Experience)

  • 5–7 years of experience in UX/UI, digital design, or eCommerce experience design
  • Proven success in site optimization, customer journey mapping, and working cross-functionally in DTC or retail eCommerce environments
  • Strong portfolio of eCommerce page design and UX improvements backed by performance metrics
  • Skilled in Shopify, Figma, heatmaping tools, GA4 and UX testing methodologies
  • Experience using AI-driven merchandising and personalization platforms (and/or Nosto or other personalization/merchandising tools) to enhance collection logic.

Capabilities

  • Strong visual and analytical thinking — able to balance aesthetics, functionality, and conversion goals simultaneously
  • Ability to distill user behavior data into actionable design decisions and advocate for the customer while supporting business outcomes
  • Deep understanding of responsive design and mobile-first best practices
  • Highly collaborative; works fluidly across Creative, Merchandising, Retention, and Performance Marketing
  • Adaptable and execution-focused in a fast-paced, evolving eCommerce environment
  • AI-fluent" requirement covering daily LLM use, prompt engineering basics, critical evaluation of AI output.

Why This Role Matters

The digital storefront is Travelpro's most visible expression of its brand transformation — and the primary engine of DTC revenue. This role is the architect of that experience, directly influencing whether a visitor becomes a buyer and whether a buyer becomes a loyal customer. By bridging design intuition with conversion data, the DTC Consumer Experience Partner ensures that every site touchpoint works harder for the business. Success here compounds: better experiences drive better metrics, which fund further investment in the brand's evolution.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, eCommerce, or related field — or equivalent experience
  • UX/UI certifications and Shopify expertise strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms, SEO fundamentals, and analytics tools (GA4 or similar), Klaviyo.


Working Environment

  • Hybrid office environment with hands-on interaction with physical product

What We Offer


A Culture Built for Growth:

We believe in collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. We move fast, support one another, and challenge ourselves to keep evolving.


Flexibility & Wellbeing:

Flexible Time Away, company-paid holidays, and hybrid work flexibility.


Comprehensive Benefits:

Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts, and wellness programs.


Invest in Your Future:

401(k) company match.


Community & Connection:

Employee-led engagement initiatives focused on wellbeing, collaboration, and creating a workplace where everyone belongs.

About Travelpro®


Travelpro® was founded by airline pilot Bob Plath, whose firsthand travel experience inspired the invention of the original Rollaboard® suitcase — changing modern travel forever. Today, we are building on that legacy as we evolve into a modern mobility and travel lifestyle brand designed for today’s global traveler. Our products combine aviation-level performance with elevated design, helping ambitious people move confidently through every journey.


Travelpro®


Tested by the Best. Designed for What’s Next.


Travelpro® is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.


Travelpro® is a drug-free workplace.

title: IT Infrastructure Technician
description:
At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role: IT Infrastructure Technician

The TechOps team supports Elanco Manufacturing and Research and Development sites across North America. As an IT Infrastructure Technician, you will be based on-site at the Clinton, Indiana Manufacturing facility, providing hands-on IT support across infrastructure, end-user technologies, and local IT services in a regulated manufacturing and laboratory environment.

Your Responsibilities

  • Ensure continuity and reliability of critical IT hardware, software, and infrastructure to support uninterrupted site operations
  • Provide deskside and end-user technical support, including break/fix and IMAC services for PCs, laptops, printers, iDevices, Windows 11, Microsoft Office, O365, Teams video conferencing, and telephony
  • Deliver last-mile support for site network equipment, cabling, connectivity, server rooms, and manufacturing and laboratory IT infrastructure
  • Manage local IT assets, configuration items, incidents, requests, and changes using ServiceNow
  • Execute local IT infrastructure projects, lifecycle management activities, and equipment procurement while maintaining accurate documentation and SOPs

What You Need to Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Networking, Computer Engineering, IT Systems Engineering, or equivalent certifications and practical experience
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of professional IT experience supporting end-user technologies and infrastructure in environments with 250+ users
  • Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with end-user devices, networking, wireless technologies, video conferencing systems, digital security, asset and lifecycle management, and incident management tools such as ServiceNow

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience working within the ITIL framework and IT service management practices
  • Prior collaboration with Operational Technology teams in manufacturing environments
  • Knowledge of regulated manufacturing and laboratory processes and IT-supported systems

Additional Information

  • Location: Clinton, Indiana (primary on-site location), Terre Haute as a secondary site
  • Work Schedule: Standard 8-hour day shift, Monday through Friday
  • Travel: Minimal travel required
  • Some on-call or on-site support may be required to support 24/7 manufacturing operations
  • Role requires regular presence in production and R&D environments

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!


Elanco Benefits and Perks:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package focusing on financial, physical, and mental well-being while encouraging our employees to pursue our purpose! Some highlights include:

  • Multiple relocation packages for eligible roles
  • Two weeklong shutdowns (mid-summer and year-end) in the US (in addition to PTO)
  • 8-week parental leave
  • 9 Employee Resource Groups
  • Annual bonus offering
  • Up to 6% 401K matching

Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. title: LANDSCAPER JB
description:
The Best Teams are Created and Maintained Here.

Job Summary

  • The Landscaper I provide landscape maintenance support to a variety of industrial, commercial, and public properties. This position involves performing basic landscaping tasks under supervision, supporting the safe operation of commercial-grade landscaping equipment, and assisting with the maintenance of plant materials and other landscape features.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Cut turf using various-sized power mowers, trimming, and edging using a gas-powered edger/trimmer, and operating a gas-powered blower
  • Prune shrubs and low trees as needed to improve the shape or growth habit, or to remove damaged branches
  • Plant and maintain flower beds
  • Operate the edger and line trimmer along sidewalks, flower beds, trees, buildings, fences, and other objects
  • Pick up trash and blow leaves and other organic debris onto the turf before mowing.
  • Mulch the leaves and organic matter when mowing
  • Perform weeding by hand or using a garden hoe or hula hoe
  • Perform basic, preventative maintenance to extend the life of equipment
  • Properly remove trash, dead plants, and suckers from the landscape
  • Maintain a polite, friendly, responsive demeanor with guests and customers
  • Report unsafe conditions to the Crew Leader as appropriate

Education and Experience:

  • At least 18 years old,
  • Enthusiastic and dependable
  • Ability to safely work with equipment like power saws and cutters
  • Certified on level 1 equipment (backpack blower, stick edger, string trimmer, walk-behind mower)
  • Familiar with basic horticultural maintenance operations/practices

Physical Demands/Requirements:

  • Ability to lift and carry 40 lbs. (mulch, fertilizer, etc.)
  • Ability to load/unload burlaps with plant cuttings onto trailer (up to 50 lbs.)
  • Be at least 18 years old (21 if operating company provided vehicles)
  • Possess strong stamina and have the ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions including extreme heat and cold.
  • Able to safely operate landscaping equipment (e.g., mowers, trimmers, blowers, edgers).
  • Able to bend, stoop, kneel, twist, stand, walk continuously throughout the day and perform repetitive motions for extended periods.
  • Able to perform manual labor using a variety of hand tools (e.g. shovels, rakes)
  • You are able to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (e.g., safety shoes, high-visibility clothing, hand protection, eye protection, hearing protection, head protection)
  • Landscapers who will be operating a BrightView fleet vehicle are required to have a valid driver’s license and meet company standards as it relates motor vehicle performance identified on a state issued motor vehicle record check.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends or holidays if needed.
  • Ability to maintain, in your possession at all times, required medications to address any known allergic reactions should they occur.

Work Environment:

  • Ability to work outdoors/indoors in moderate to extreme weather conditions (e.g., temperatures more than 100°F, temperatures below 32°F, various levels of humidity)
  • Ability to work in direct sunlight for extended periods of time.
  • Work outdoors near automotive traffic, bodies of water, fumes, dust, mechanical and/or electrical hazards.
  • Ability to work in environments where extended periods of loud noise are present.
  • Ability to work in environments where exposure to allergens such as pollen and rag weed, insects such as bees and spiders and reptiles such as lizards and snakes.

BrightView Landscapes, LLC is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

BrightView offers a suite or health, wellness, and financial benefits to full-time team members. Benefits offerings for full-time team members include medical, dental, and vision insurance, ancillary and voluntary products, a 401k savings plan with employer contributions, and 6 to 9 company paid holidays per year. Employees may also be eligible to receive paid time off for vacation and/or sick leave, tuition reimbursement, and/or potential variable pay opportunities based on position and performance. A detailed benefits package will be provided during the interview process.

It’s Not Just a Team. It’s One BrightView.

Job Description:

Join GDIT and support the U.S. Army by leading complex radar capability development at Tobyhanna Army Depot in Pennsylvania. As the Radar Project Coordinator, you will serve as the senior technical project manager responsible for planning, acquisition, logistics, engineering integration, testing, installation, and sustainment of multiple advanced radar initiatives. You will lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with TYAD leadership, government stakeholders, OEM partners, contractors, engineers, logistics personnel, and depot artisans to deliver mission critical capabilities on time and within budget.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Lead end to end execution of radar capability projects from planning and design through acquisition, facility engineering, installation, testing, acceptance, documentation, and transition to sustainment.
  • Direct capability development supporting Sentinel A4, AN/TPY 4, ARTS V3, AN/TPQ 53, LRDR, associated LRUs, the Radar Engineering Laboratory, and next generation radar CCA repair capability.
  • Build and manage Integrated Master Schedules that incorporate equipment lead times, facility milestones, installation sequencing, calibration timelines, and training events.
  • Lead engineering assessments and facility integration for radar test stations, radar ranges, TMDE benches, CCA rework cells, engineering laboratories, electrical upgrades, CDA/N2 systems, DI water loops, fume extraction, and workspace design.
  • Oversee specification development and integration of PXI systems, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, RF amplifiers, power meters, and advanced diagnostic systems.
  • Manage project risks, schedules, budgets, technical documentation, and mitigation strategies while standardizing workflows using Lean and Six Sigma practices.
  • Ensure project activities comply with applicable IPC, J STD, ESD, OSHA, NIST, HazMat, base access, environmental, and safety requirements.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between TYAD leadership, OEM partners, contractors, and government stakeholders.
  • Produce technical data packages, layout plans, utility reports, system acceptance test plans, progress reports, and final acceptance documentation.
  • Perform facility walkthroughs, equipment validation checks, safety inspections, installation oversight, and support equipment setup as required.
  • Travel up to 10 percent to OEM sites, vendor facilities, training venues, and engineering coordination meetings.

Requirements for Success

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Engineering degree preferred but not required.
  • 5 or more years of technical project or program management experience in engineering, defense sustainment, electronics manufacturing, radar systems, or DoD capability development.
  • Experience coordinating technical programs involving radar systems, electronics repair, TMDE instrumentation, facility engineering, and lifecycle sustainment.
  • Expertise in project management, engineering coordination, facility integration, RF systems, scheduling, risk management, budgeting, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications and integrate electrical, RF, mechanical, and software requirements across complex systems.
  • Must have and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP certification.
  • Experience with advanced RF test equipment, digital instrumentation, and diagnostic systems.
  • Experience supporting advanced radar capability development, depot repair, or sustainment programs.

GDIT Is Your Place

At GDIT, our people are at the center of everything we do. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, a 401(k) with company match, career development opportunities, internal mobility, and the opportunity to support critical Army missions in a collaborative, mission focused environment.

Own Your Opportunity

Build your career with a team that values technical excellence, disciplined execution, innovation, and continuous learning while delivering advanced radar capabilities that directly support warfighter readiness.

title: eInvoicing Solution Enablement Consultant
description:
About Fintua

Fintua is a global indirect tax compliance and tax technology business. Its platform supports VAT compliance, recovery, eInvoicing and payments, helping organisations manage complex indirect tax obligations across multiple jurisdictions.

Fintua is part of CluneTech, a suite of companies providing cutting-edge solutions that simplify global business. We have been recognised as a Great Place to Work for 11 consecutive years, a “Best Workplace for Women” for the past 7 years and most recently, we were delighted to be recognised as a “Best Workplace in Tech” for the past 6 years.

Role Purpose

The eInvoicing Solution Enablement Consultant bridges regulatory requirements, technical capability and customer needs. The role combines deep knowledge of global eInvoicing regulation with solution consulting, commercial support and client-facing expertise, enabling customers, partners and internal teams to understand how Fintua’s platform addresses their compliance and operational requirements.

Working closely with Sales, Product, Client Onboarding, Research & Regulatory Intelligence and the Solution Implementation Team, the role supports strategic opportunities, shapes compliant solution approaches, develops enablement content and helps customers adopt Fintua’s eInvoicing capabilities. The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser throughout pre-sales, solution design, onboarding and early adoption, while feeding customer, regulatory and market insight back into the business.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Consultancy & Sales Enablement

  • Act as the eInvoicing subject-matter expert for strategic customer and partner opportunities.

  • Participate in discovery workshops to understand customer processes, ERP landscapes, data flows, regulatory obligations and implementation constraints.

  • Translate customer requirements into clear solution approaches aligned with Fintua’s standard capabilities and delivery model.

  • Support solution demonstrations, RFPs, RFIs, proposals and commercial presentations.

  • Help Sales articulate the regulatory, operational and technical value of Fintua’s eInvoicing proposition.

  • Identify non-standard requirements, delivery dependencies and implementation risks before contractual commitments are finalised.

  • Ensure customer expectations, solution scope and implementation assumptions are clearly documented and understood.

Regulatory & Technical Enablement

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of global eInvoicing, digital reporting and indirect tax developments, including Continuous Transaction Controls, Peppol, ViDA, SAF-T, VAT and GST requirements.

  • Translate regulatory requirements into practical customer guidance, business requirements and technical considerations.

  • Explain regulatory change clearly to customers, partners, Sales, Product, Onboarding and operational teams.

  • Work closely with Research & Regulatory Intelligence to ensure customer-facing guidance is current, accurate and consistently applied.

  • Assess the implications of regulatory requirements for invoice formats, clearance models, reporting, archiving, digital signatures, authentication and data retention while working with our eInvoice partner.

Customer & Partner Enablement

  • Design and deliver customer workshops, solution briefings and eInvoicing education sessions.

  • Develop implementation guides, playbooks, FAQs, best-practice guidance and self-service learning content.

  • Create reusable customer-facing materials that simplify complex regulatory and technical topics.

  • Support partner enablement so implementation, referral and technology partners can position and explain Fintua consistently.

  • Help customers understand how platform capabilities address their operational, compliance and adoption requirements.

Product, Onboarding & Implementation Collaboration

  • Provide regulatory and customer insight into product design, roadmap discussions and release readiness.

  • Support solution design reviews for complex or strategic implementations.

  • Work with Client Onboarding to confirm scope, dependencies, responsibilities and readiness before delivery begins.

  • Support the Solution Implementation Team where specialist regulatory, process or customer guidance is required.

  • Participate in testing, validation and customer acceptance activities where appropriate.

  • Capture customer and partner feedback and translate it into actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations and eInvoice partner.

Market & Thought Leadership

  • Represent Fintua at customer meetings, webinars, conferences and relevant industry forums.

  • Contribute to articles, webinars, presentations and other thought-leadership content on eInvoicing and digital reporting.

  • Support Marketing with accurate, commercially relevant regulatory and solution content.

  • Monitor market and competitor developments and share relevant insight with internal stakeholders.

Skills & Experience

  • At least five years’ relevant experience in eInvoicing, indirect tax, tax technology, ERP integration, solution consulting, pre-sales or a related field.

  • Demonstrable experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting sales opportunities, customer discovery, solution design, proposals or demonstrations.

  • Experience translating regulatory and business requirements into practical technical or operational solutions.

  • Experience delivering workshops, presentations, training or customer-facing guidance.

  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance customer needs, regulatory requirements and delivery feasibility.

Technical & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Global eInvoicing frameworks and country mandate models.

  • Continuous Transaction Controls and real-time invoice clearance.

  • Peppol network, Peppol BIS and related interoperability standards.

  • ViDA and Digital Reporting Requirements.

  • SAF-T, VAT and GST compliance requirements.

  • Structured invoice formats, including XML, UBL and EDIFACT.

  • ERP environments such as SAP, Oracle and Microsoft Dynamics.

  • API-based integrations, invoice data flows and common implementation patterns.

  • Electronic document archiving, digital signatures, authentication and audit requirements.

  • The role requires sufficient technical depth to discuss integrations, solution architecture and implementation approaches with customers, internal technical teams and eInvoice partner. It is not a software-development role.

At Fintua, we are a community of like-minded individuals committed to excellence in everything we do. We create an innovative, collaborative, and supportive workplace that allows our brilliant people to unleash their potential.

Recognised as a both a Great Place to Work and Deloitte Best Managed Company, we believe that recognition goes much deeper than just financial rewards. Therefore, in addition to a competitive salary, we also offer an exclusive benefits package that includes:

  • Flexible Working Policy with a combination of remote and office working and a flexible approach to working hours

  • Rewards & Recognition

  • Employee Wellbeing Programme, CluneTech Life

Fintua is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees. We are committed to building and maintaining a culture which is free from discrimination and harassment and where all employees can bring their best selves to work.

title: Lead - Forecast Governance & Process Oversight Analyst
description:
Every career journey is personal. That's why we empower you with the tools and support to create your own success story.

Be challenged. Be heard. Be valued. Be you ... be here.

Job Summary

The Forecast Governance and Process Oversight Lead Analyst will support the governance framework for enterprise forecasting and budgeting activities, ensuring processes are well documented, consistently executed, appropriately monitored, and aligned to applicable policies, controls, and risk management expectations. This role will partner across Finance, Risk, Control, Technology, and business process owners to maintain forecasting and budget policies, process inventories, process maps, documentation standards, the forecast taxonomy, forecast health metrics, and Archer-related issue and control artifacts. The Lead Analyst will draft and maintain governance documentation, coordinate process intake and updates, monitor adherence to defined forecast lifecycle expectations, identify and escalate process health concerns, and support issue management activities in Archer.


Essential Job Functions

  • Own and maintain forecasting and budget documentation, including policies, standards, process inventories, process maps, taxonomy, SOPs, desktop references and supporting artifacts. Coordinate periodic reviews, updates, approvals, version control and stakeholder alignment to ensure documentation remains current, complete, auditable and aligned to the end-to-end forecast lifecycle. - (30%)
  • Lead process inventory and process mapping activities for forecasting and budget processes, including identification of process ownership, inputs, outputs, dependencies, control points, handoffs, documentation gaps and opportunities for standardization. Maintain alignment between process maps, forecast taxonomy, Archer process structures, governance artifacts and operational playbooks. - (25%)
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor forecast health measure that assess process adherence, documentation completeness, control execution, cycle readiness, timing, data and input availability, adjustment behavior, review and challenge completion, approval status and emerging governance risks. Prepare clear reporting, escalate material concerns and support remediation plans with process owners. - (25%)
  • Maintain Archer-related forecasting and budgeting issues, risk, control and process artifacts, including issue updates, action plan tracking, evidence collection, status reporting and coordination with control partners. Support governance routines that ensure issues are documented, monitored, escalated, remediated and closed in accordance with applicable standards. - (20%)


Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • 8-10 years of professional experience in finance, financial planning and analysis, forecasting, budgeting, governance, controls, risk management, audit, project management or equivalent, relevant work experience.
  • Experience with Archer, enterprise risk management tools, policy governance, process mapping, controls documentation, issue management, or audit remediation.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Analytics, Economics, Risk Management or equivalent, relevant work experience.
  • 10-13 years of professional experience in finance, governance, FP&A, forecasting, budgeting, controls, process improvement, or financial project management.
  • Experience building or enhancing governance frameworks, processes, and controls within financial services or other regulated environments.
  • Strong process mapping and documentation experience, including SOPs, procedures, and governance artifacts.


Skills

  • Financial Governance
  • Policy Management
  • Process Mapping

title: Mental Health Aide I or II (Respite)
description:
Mental Health Aide I or II (Respite)

Job Overview

Location/Schedule: This position will be located at Tigard Respite.
The schedule for this position is Sunday through Thursday, 3:00 p.m. to 11:30 p.m.

Position: Mental Health Aide I or II

Program: Respite

Mission

Cascadia Health delivers whole health care – integrated mental health and addiction services, primary care, and housing – to promote hope and support the well-being of the communities we serve.

Vision

We envision a community where everyone benefits from whole health care, experiences well-being, and has a self-directed, connected life.

Description: Respite is a voluntary program that occurs within a safe and relaxed atmosphere, away from the stressors that may be impacting an individual's sense of security and stability. Residents at Respite receive three meals a day, interact in the milieu, explore hobbies, take a walk in a quiet neighborhood setting, and always receive on-site support from caring and skillful respite staff. Respite provides support for individuals who need further stabilization due to recent medication adjustment or needs a break from current living situation which appears to be increasing psychiatric symptoms and is diagnosed with a mental illness.

Position Summary: As a Mental Health Aide at Cascadia Health, you will play a vital role in supporting individuals with mental health challenges within our residential settings. Your responsibilities include assisting with daily living activities, implementing individualized care plans, and fostering a safe, supportive environment for our residents. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team to promote recovery and enhance the overall well-being of those in your care. This position requires compassion, patience, and a commitment to providing high-quality, trauma-informed care.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide individual and group based therapeutic interventions for residents as directed by the mental health treatment plan and meet productivity standards.

  • Provide supervision and support to residents in areas of self-care, hygiene, housekeeping, meal preparation, use of public transportation, supporting residents with community integration and social skills and other areas of support.

  • Coordinate with shift partner(s) and staff ending shift regarding resident concerns, needed follow-up, building/program needs, etc.

  • Accompany residents to, and assist residents during various types of appointments, outings and activities out in the community, generally using a company provided vehicle, i.e. smaller or larger passenger van, when possible

  • Provide medication administration; administer medications following the providers orders using a Medication Administration Report (MAR).

  • Review daily cleaning schedule and collaborate with staff to ensure daily household chores are completed. This includes, but is not limited to, light housekeeping and cleaning of biohazards. Additionally, may assist in meal set-up, preparation, serving, and clean up related to mealtimes or cooking group activities.

  • Assist in crisis situations and with de-escalating residents that are in crisis or experiencing significant struggles. Follow emergency protocols and procedures including use of non-violent crisis intervention and de-escalation techniques (Pro-ACT)

  • Adhere to compliance, required laws and trainings, safety of property and staff, regulations, I.e. Mandatory abuse reporting laws and HIPPA, fire regulations

  • Participate in all scheduled staff meetings, supervision sessions, and other departmental and agency meetings.

  • Document and maintain clinical records in a manner that assures compliance with all agency policy and procedures and local, state and federal regulations through use of Electronic Health Record System (EHR)

  • Complete annul employee training requirements to understand how to conduct ethical work, for professional development, and stay in compliance

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Mental Health Aide I:

  • Required: High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Compensation: Base Pay $21.90/hr. to $ 22.56/hr. DOE

  • Mental Health Aide II:

    Must meet the requirements and demonstrate the competencies to be credentialed as a Qualified Mental Health Associate (QMHA).

    Required: Must have a bachelor’s degree in an approved behavioral science field from an accredited college or university or three years of mental health work experience.

    Required: Certification must be current and in compliance with MHACBO.

    Compensation: Base Pay $24.81/hr. to $25.84/hr. DOE

  • Experience in a residential mental health setting and providing skills training services is preferred but not required.

  • Proficient verbal and written communication skills.

  • Basic knowledge of Trauma Informed Care (TIC), Motivational Interviewing, and Evidence-Based Practices.

  • Basic understanding of recovery models, illness management, and strength-based philosophies.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word & Excel).

  • CPR Certification (training provided post-hire).

Working Conditions:

  • Environmental: Work is generally performed in a supportive/supported housing facility and occasionally in the community. Universal precautions should be taken due to exposure to disease, biohazards, noise, and contaminants.

  • Operating Hours: Mental Health Aides operate on three shifts within a 24/7 window: day shift (7:00 am to 3:30 pm), swing shift (3:00 pm to 11:30 pm), and overnight shift (11:00 pm to 7:30 am). title: Process Engineer - IGT
description:
Howmet Engine Systems is currently seeking an experienced Engineering professional to join our team in Hampton, Virginia. Are you an empowered Lead Team Partner with the drive to transform ideas into sustainable value? We are seeking individuals who have a demonstrated ability to achieve results in a manufacturing environment, as well as the passion to put that experience to work to lead activities and support plant/location team to achieve manufacturing excellence. Our organization is dedicated to rapid, profitable growth through operational excellence and career development. If you are an energetic professional that wants to be a part of a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply.

Job Summary

As a Process Engineer you will be responsible for all the metallurgical/materials characteristics pertaining to the investment casting process and our products. This may involve both new development and production castings. In this role you will be teamed up with a Product Engineer who will be responsible for the dimensional aspects of the process/product. The prime responsibility for this position is to engineer the highest yield and lowest overall cost product while meeting or exceeding all customer defined quality requirements. In this position you will work in a team environment with other engineers as well as hands-on with the manufacturing team so strong communication skills are required.

Salary:

Anticipated Pay Range: $50K-100K per year. *Pay rates within this range are determined based on various factors including experience, education, certifications, etc.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities

  • Follows Howmet’s Safety Regulations and work Rules Handbook along with all department specific safety requirements.
  • Develops and debugs processes for production and developmental castings.
  • Actively pursues the continuous improvement of existing processes.
  • Supplies technical support to customers. Interacts with them regarding technical concerns
  • Complies with all company attendance policies and guidelines; this includes, but is not limited to, regular attendance and some overtime.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities

  • Reads, analyzes, and interprets technical procedures. Effectively write reports, business correspondence, and procedures. Presents information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Applies mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
  • Solves practical problems and deals with a variety of variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Communicates effectively with all levels of the organization to achieve goals.
  • Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Motivated to continuously drive improvement in assigned portfolio of parts.
  • Leadership ability is desired as this position benefits from being an influential engineer and demonstrated leadership is a plus as the potential advancement exists in 2-4 years.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from an accredited college or university.
  • Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Must be able to provide documentation in the original form establishing both your identity and your employment eligibility in the U.S.
  • This position entails access to export-controlled items and employment offers are conditioned upon an applicant's ability to lawfully attain access to such items.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Metallurgical, Materials, or Chemical Engineering from an accredited college or university.
  • Investment casting experience
  • Coursework or equivalent experience in basic statistical and analytical tools
  • 3 years in a manufacturing environment

title: Production Specialist
description:
Role Overview

The BSA Production Specialist is responsible for supporting daily production operations within the Battery System Assembly (BSA) area by assisting with battery system assembly processes, driving process improvements, and serving as a technical resource for production teams. This role plays a critical part in achieving safety, quality, delivery, and productivity targets while supporting training initiatives, standardized work practices, and operational excellence.

The BSA Production Specialist collaborates closely with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Materials teams to identify and resolve operational issues, improve manufacturing performance, and support continuous improvement efforts. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to maintaining high standards in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)

  • Utilize product and equipment knowledge to maximize production efficiency while ensuring the manufacture of high-quality battery system products.
  • Support issue resolution by conducting root cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to drive rapid and sustainable performance improvements.
  • Partner with Process Engineering to troubleshoot manufacturing issues and support initiatives focused on reducing scrap, cycle time, and equipment downtime.
  • Ensure adherence to established procedures for data collection, documentation, reporting, and process controls.
  • Coordinate the effective utilization of raw materials, components, and production resources to support operational goals.
  • Monitor daily production performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs), driving actions to achieve departmental objectives.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, cost reduction, productivity, efficiency, and environmental performance.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Materials, Maintenance, Quality, and other internal departments to resolve production-related challenges.
  • Assist in coaching and developing Production Supervisors and team members on standardized work practices, problem-solving techniques, and continuous improvement principles.
  • Promote consistent work practices and ensure production teams follow established standard operating procedures across all shifts.
  • Support training activities by providing technical guidance and assistance to production team members regarding processes, equipment, and best practices.
  • Participate in Kaizen events and continuous improvement projects to enhance operational performance and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Support new product launches, equipment implementation activities, and process changes as required.
  • Assist in maintaining a safe work environment by identifying hazards and promoting adherence to safety policies and procedures.

AUTHORITY & SCOPE This role operates within defined corporate policies and procedures and exercises judgment appropriate to its level of responsibility. The position may influence decisions related to functional operations, processes, or recommendations and escalate matters as required

Qualifications (The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required and preferred for this position.)

Required Education & Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of manufacturing, assembly, or production experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while managing multiple priorities.

Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Strong sense of urgency and commitment to achieving production goals and departmental objectives.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated accountability, ownership, and commitment to delivering results.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Business Management, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience in automotive, battery manufacturing, electronics, EV manufacturing, or advanced manufacturing environments.
  • Experience supporting battery pack or battery system assembly operations.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies

Working Conditions:

  • Frequent standing, walking, and movement throughout the manufacturing facility.
  • Occasional lifting of up to 35 pounds.
  • Required use of personal protective equipment (PPE).

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Pantheon Data (a Kenific Holding company) is a private, small business based in the Washington, DC, area. Pantheon Data was founded in 2011, initially providing acquisition and supply chain management services to the US Coast Guard. Our service offerings have grown in the past ten years, including infrastructure resiliency, contact center operations, information technology, software engineering, program management, strategic communications, engineering, and cybersecurity. We have also grown our customer base to include commercial clients. The company has used this experience to expand our service offerings to other agencies within the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other Federal Civilian Agencies.

Position Overview

Pantheon Data is seeking a Cloud Engineer to design and operate in a secure, cloud-native platforms within AWS GovCloud. This role focuses on supporting ML-enabled workloads and applications processing CUI, PII, and PHI. The candidate will automate gated security controls across CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) or GitLab CI/CD and administrate production-grade Amazon EKS clusters via GitOps methodologies under strict federal compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, DoD SRG).

Responsibilities

  • Secure Infrastructure: Design hardened AWS GovCloud environments using Terraform, ensuring alignment with NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP baselines.
  • Kubernetes & GitOps: Manage lifecycle, networking, and security for Amazon EKS clusters. Orchestrate deployments using Helm charts and GitOps tools (e.g., Argo CD or Flux) to ensure declarative state management.
  • Secure CI/CD Engineering: Design and implement robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD. Integrate and configure GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) and additional relevant tools, including CodeQL for SAST, secret scanning, and dependency review.
  • ML Workload Support: Deploy and scale containerized ML models and data pipelines, optimizing performance and observability in regulated environments.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Professional Experience: 3+ years in DevSecOps/DevOps with a focus on production AWS environments.
  • CI/CD Expertise: Proven experience building enterprise-grade pipelines with GitHub Actions or other CI/CD tools and deep technical knowledge of code security tools.
  • Container Orchestration: Deep hands-on expertise with Amazon EKS, including cluster hardening, OCI-compliant image management, and Helm package management.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency in Terraform (modular design, state management) for complex networking and security stacks.
  • Federal Compliance: Practical understanding of NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, or DoD RMF and their application to technical configurations in GovCloud.
  • Automation: Scripting proficiency in Python or Bash for operational automation and security tooling.
  • Certification: Current AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Security - Specialty.
  • Ability to work effectively remotely in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and produce quality work.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite software including Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • 3+ years of professional, hands-on experience in a DevOps or DevSecOps engineering role, including responsibility for production or pre-production environments.
  • At least one current AWS certification recommended, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or AWS Certified Security.

Clearance Requirements

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements. Secret Clearance is required for continued employment.

Work Location: Reston, VA - Remote

  • Our company prioritizes the benefits of flexibility and collaboration, whether that happens in person or remotely.
  • If the position is remote or hybrid, you may periodically work from a Pantheon Data office location or client site.
  • If this position is assigned to a Pantheon Data office location or client site, you'll work with colleagues and clients in person, as needed for specific client requirements.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $130,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Benefits Overview

We are always looking for good people! Pantheon Data is committed to providing its employees with competitive salaries and benefits in order to increase employee satisfaction and productivity. In addition to our benefits, we also offer SmartBenefits through the Washington Metro Area Transportation Authority, where you specify an amount of your pre-tax wages be paid directly to your SmarTrip account. In some cases, tuition assistance may be available for continuing education expenses and certifications related to their position. Additional details may be found at
