title: Process Operator - Heap Leach
description:
Who Are We?


SSR Mining Inc. is an intermediate gold company with four producing assets located in the USA, Canada, and Argentina, combined with a global pipeline of high-quality development and exploration assets in the USA, Turkey, and Canada.


SSR’s commitment to safety, collaboration, and excellence allows us to continue building upon our already strong foundation. With an industry-leading pipeline of projects, strong financial positioning, and talented employees, we look forward to our bright future!




Job Description:

General Objectives:

Reporting to the Process Supervisor, the Heap Leach Operator typically works a 4-day, 10-hour schedule. The Operator builds, dismantles, and replaces panels, connects yelomine, deploys drip emitters, fuses HDPE pipes, adjusts flows and changes filters and monitors the overall performance of leach pad as needed in an efficient and safe manner.

Key Areas of Responsibilities & Duties:

The key responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Works in a safe and efficient manner. Maintains safe attitude and looks out for others.

  • Participates in good housekeeping in all areas including, shoveling of crusher spillage, maintaining clean work environment in equipment and light vehicles.

  • Participates in weekly assignments of cleaning lunchroom and rest rooms.

  • Performs daily walk around inspections of work area and light vehicle/equipment inspections.

  • Assists with piping of the heap leach pad in a safe and efficient manner.

  • Shovels and hoses down areas for cleanup in a safe manner.

  • Fuels light vehicles and support equipment without spillage.

  • Performs light maintenance such as greasing equipment.

  • Drags yellow mine pipe and emitter tubing with assistance.

  • Travels independently in light vehicles to and from heap leach and lay down yards around mobile equipment in a safe manner.

  • Understands supplies and tools required for jobs and can safely and efficiently gather supplies and tools as directed.

Required Skills:

  • Ability to effectively report all incidents and accidents to supervisor.

  • Efficiently report spills, mortalities, etc. to supervisor.

  • Ability to work without creating petroleum or chemical spills.

  • Must be able to wear appropriate PPE including but not limited to footwear, high visibility clothing, and eye and hearing protection.

  • Ability to work safely around mobile equipment.

  • Can describe issues with work area to aid operations and direct maintenance work.

  • Communicates with coworkers and supervisors in a professional and courteous manner.

  • Must be a self-starter and can complete work with little or no direct supervision.

Other Requirements/Experience:

  • Must meet respirator standards and use respirators when required.

  • Prior experience in process operations such as mill, crusher, heap leach or plant experience, preferred.

  • Mechanical aptitude, preferred.

  • Can work safely with chemicals including lime, cyanide and caustic.

  • Experience working outdoors in all weather conditions.

  • Ability to communicate effectively, in English, using all standard forms of business communication.

  • Must have good safety and attendance records.

  • Willing to work weekends as scheduled.

  • Candidate is able to routinely lift 50 pounds.

  • Valid driver license.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Operations

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience building high-performing leadership teams and developing organizational capability through periods of significant growth.

Leadership Competencies

Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.

Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.

Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.

Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.

Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others

  • Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. title: Operátor výroby sterilních mastí (m/ž)
description:
Hledáte práci, která má smysl? V Zentivě vyrábíme kvalitní a cenově dostupné léky pro více než 100 milionů lidí ve 40 zemích. Přidejte se k našemu týmu v Praze a buďte součástí výroby, která má skutečný dopad na zdraví lidí.

Rozšiřujeme výrobu léků a hledáme nové kolegy, kteří mají technické myšlení. Budete pracovat s moderním výrobním vybavením v čistém prostředí. Zkušenosti z farmaceutické výroby nepotřebujete – vše potřebné vás naučíme.

Co u nás budete dělat?

  • Budete se podílet na výrobě léčivých přípravků podle přesně stanovených postupů a postupně poznáte jednotlivé fáze výrobního procesu.
  • Naučíte se obsluhovat výrobní zařízení a pracovat s tlakovými kotli včetně jejich připojení, manipulace a posunu.
  • Budete zajišťovat čištění a sterilizaci zařízení po každé výrobě a dbát na čistotu a správné podmínky výrobního prostředí.
  • Budete vést výrobní dokumentaci a pečlivě zaznamenávat jednotlivé kroky a údaje související s výrobou.
  • Osvojíte si práci v prostředí, kde je důležitá přesnost, pečlivost a důsledné dodržování stanovených postupů.
  • Budete dodržovat přísné hygienické a farmaceutické standardy, včetně používání ochranného oblečení a pravidel pro vstup do výrobních prostor.
  • Nemusíte mít obavy, že budete všechno umět hned od prvního dne. Jednotlivé procesy jsou detailně popsány v přehledné dokumentaci a zpočátku vás podpoří zkušenější kolegové.
  • Stanete se součástí týmu, kde každý svým dílem přispívá k bezpečné a kvalitní výrobě léčivých přípravků.
  • Pracujeme ve dvousměnném provozu: 6:00–14:00 a 14:00–22:00, výhledově třísměnném.
  • Pracujeme pouze v pracovní dny, takže víkendy máte volné.

Koho hledáme?

Hledáme spolehlivého kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á má smysl pro detail a nevadí mu práce v čistém výrobním prostředí.

Oceníme zejména:

  • pečlivost a zodpovědný přístup k práci
  • ochotu pracovat v čistých prostorech s přísnými hygienickými pravidly (speciální pracovní oblečení a převlékání během směny)
  • základní znalost práce na PC
  • technické myšlení nebo technické vzdělání (výhodou)
  • schopnost správně zapojit zařízení a řešit základní provozní situace
  • znalost českého jazyka slovem i písmem (kvůli práci s dokumentací)
  • schopnost pracovat samostatně i jako součást týmu
  • ochotu pracovat ve směnném provozu

Co vám nabízíme?

  • Jistotu práce u stabilního zaměstnavatele. Zentiva navazuje na 100letou historii výroby léčiv v Praze - Dolních Měcholupech. Dlouhodobě se také řadíme mezi oceňované zaměstnavatele v České republice.
  • Zapomeňte na horké haly nebo práci venku. Pracovat budete ve velmi čistém prostředí s celoroční teplotou okolo 22 °C.
  • Operátoři si u nás vydělají až 38 000 Kč měsíčně – včetně příplatků za směnnost a bonusů. Peníze budete mít na účtu vždy včas a mzdy každoročně navyšujeme.
  • K tomu získáte 12 000 Kč ročně na benefity prostřednictvím Cafeterie eBenefity. Částku čerpáte formou 12 000 bodů, které můžete využít na dovolenou, v lékárnách, sportovních zařízeních, na kulturu i knihy.
  • Týden dovolené navíc (celkem 25 dní) pro zasloužený odpočinek. K tomu ještě tři dny zdravotního volna ročně.
  • Volný čas si můžete zpestřit i díky Multisport kartě, na kterou přispíváme – díky tomu vás bude stát pouze 390 Kč měsíčně.
  • Příspěvek na stravování – na účet vám každý měsíc vyplatíme stravenkový paušál, a to v hodnotě 115 Kč za odpracovaný den.
  • Přímo v budově máme kantýnu se snídaněmi, několika druhy obědů (včetně vegetariánských), automaty na svačiny a samozřejmě kávu zdarma.
  • Přispějeme vám na penzijní doplňkové spoření/ dlouhodobý investiční produkt (DIP) a životní pojištění.
  • Relokační bonus – pokud se za prací u nás stěhujete z oblasti mimo Středočeský kraj, budeme vám prvního půl roku vyplácet 6 000 Kč měsíčně navíc do výplaty.
  • Nehodíme vás do vody. Hned na začátku vás čeká důkladné proškolení a následně podpora od zkušeného kolegy pro váš pohodový start. Bezpečnost při práci je pro nás vždy na prvním místě.
  • Veškeré pracovní vybavení, od oblečení až po obuv, od nás samozřejmě dostanete zdarma. A o praní pracovního oblečení se postaráme.
  • Pro pohodlnější cesty do práce máme k dispozici firemní parkoviště. Přímo před budovu Zentivy jezdí autobusová linka č. 101, která navazuje na náš směnný a víkendový provoz.
  • Interní kariéra u nás není jen prázdný pojem. Pravidelně zaměstnance vzděláváme, a když povyšujeme, nejprve se vždy díváme do vlastních řad. Zaměstnanci u nás zůstávají mnoho let právě díky možnosti profesního růstu.
  • Pořádáme akce jako Dny zdraví, sportovní aktivity, sázíme stromky a pořádáme i zájmové přednášky – např. na témata zdraví a well-beingu.
  • Nástup je možný ihned. Pracovní smlouvu uzavíráte se Zentivou, nejprve na 1 rok. Při oboustranné spokojenosti vám smlouvu rádi prodloužíme na neurčito.

Jak probíhá výběrové řízení?

  • Pošlete nám svůj životopis a my se na něj co nejdříve podíváme.
  • Pokud budete splňovat naše požadavky, pozveme vás na osobní pohovor spojený s prohlídkou výroby. Dozvíte se vše potřebné k nabízené pozici a budete mít prostor zeptat se na vše, co vás zajímá.

description:
At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role: Clinical Development Scientist – Parasiticides

As a Clinical Development Scientist, you will lead the development and execution of global companion and farm animal parasiticide clinical programs supporting Elanco’s innovation pipeline. In this role, you will design, coordinate, and deliver high-quality clinical effectiveness and target animal safety (TAS) studies from early development through regulatory approval in initial target

geographies.

  • Ensure quality assurance and regulatory compliance while contributing to process improvements, procedural development, and continuous advancement of clinical development practices.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

  • Education: DVM or Ph.D. in Animal Science or related field preferred; MS with relevant experience will be considered. Advanced degree in addition to DVM is desirable.
  • Top Skills: Strong project management and organizational capabilities, excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):


  • Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities and supporting product registrations.
  • Working knowledge of GCP, GLP, GMP, and global regulatory frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and external research partners.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to drive clinical programs and align stakeholders.
  • Understanding of research and development processes within animal health or pharmaceutical industries.

Additional Information:

  • Travel: 10–20% domestic, with potential international travel.
  • Location: Indianapolis, IN – Hybrid Work Environment

title: 0000002850.JUVENILE DETENTION OFFICER II.JUVENILE DETENTION  CENTER
description:
Functions as a lead Juvenile Detention Officer in providing direct supervision to youths in a 24-hour detention facility and assists in the development and evaluation of residential programs.

Management Scope: May assume divisional responsibility in the absence of the shift supervisor. 1. Provides direct day-to-day supervision to youths in a 24-hour detention facility in manner that ensures the health, safety and welfare of each youth.

2. Functions as a lead Juvenile Detention Officer and assumes divisional responsibility in the absence of the shift supervisor.

3. Provides individual and group counseling to all youths to promote and increase personal awareness of responsibilities and alternatives.

4. Provides critical and sound judgement and decisions during crisis or potentially dangerous situations, conducts crisis intervention counseling, and notifies the supervisor of concerns.

5. Disciplines youths by enforcing the rules of the facility, documents behavior and other specific information and forwards to appropriate personnel.

6. Trains and evaluates staff and maintains time and attendance records in the absence of a shift supervisor.

7. Transports youths to and from appointments.

8. Serves as back-up to staff and assumes all duties as necessary, i.e., administering medications, transporting youths to appointments, processing intake assessments or discharges, and disciplining youths. Must be physically able to perform “handling with care techniques, including takedowns, chasing and restraining youth” as outlined in the Texas Juvenile Justice Department (TJJD) requirement.

9. Conducts inspections, rounds and drills, which include room checks and physical searches of youths.

10. Performs other duties as assigned.Education, Experience and Training:
Graduation from an accredited high school/GED program. Two (2) years of work related experience.

Special Requirements/Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing, and establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, departments and the general public. Must have current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification or obtain within 90 days of hire. Must maintain 40 hours of training yearly. Must be certified as required by applicable standards of the facility/department assigned. Must possess a valid Texas driver’s license, with a good driving record. Must pass an extensive background investigation. Mandatory drug testing prior to employment and will be subject to random, unannounced drug and/or alcohol testing during employment. The employee will also be subject to shift changes.

· “Position requires working with juveniles who may have committed dangerous/ aggressive acts; should possess a high tolerance for working in an emotionally demanding/stressful work environment.”
· May be transferred to another department, shift, location, or facility based on the needs of the Department.
· Working in a 24-hour facility may make the employee subject to working mandatory overtime or remaining on duty and working all, or a part of, an additional shift (“double shift”).
· The incumbent is / may be considered to be ‘essential personnel’ subject to being held over or called back to a work location or alternate site at all times. When required, you will be notified by your supervisor.
· Must be at least 21 years of age (for applicable positions) and must pass all portions (physical/written) of the Juvenile Academy to continue employment or all standards related to PREA and Ethics for specific positions.

Physical/Environmental Requirements:
Works inside a secured facility with potential exposure to hepatitis, tuberculosis, lice and other diseases. Ability to restrain and/or chase youths. May be required to utilize vehicle to transport youths.

title: Mid-level Associate, Americas Corporate M&A
description:
Our Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Practice is globally recognized as a top-tier leader in both public and private M&A transactions. We deliver unparalleled legal services for complex corporate deals, offering strategic planning, due diligence, negotiation, and execution of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and other business combinations. Serving a diverse clientele, including multinational corporations, private equity firms and banks, our team ensures regulatory compliance, manages risk, and structures transactions for optimal outcomes. By combining extensive legal expertise with deep market insight, we help clients navigate high-stakes transactions, fostering growth and creating value, solidifying our reputation as one of the premier M&A practices worldwide.

Firm Summary

White & Case is an elite global law firm serving leading companies, financial institutions and governments worldwide. Our long history as an international firm means we are perfectly placed to help our clients resolve their most complex legal challenges wherever they may be.

With lawyers operating from more than 40 locations, working in virtually every country of the world, we have invested heavily in building a high-quality full-service practice competing at the top of the market. We are distinguished by our on-the-ground presence in the world’s key financial markets and our strengths in handling complex cross-border work.

It’s not just about our global network of offices; it’s the global interconnectedness of the Firm that our people, and our clients, value most. We work well together across geographic and practice boundaries. It’s one of the reasons we attract and retain cross-border work. And why we attract a diverse group of people.

Our lawyers are globally minded, enterprising, collaborative and committed to excellence. Our people represent 90 nationalities and speak 80 languages.

Duties and Accountabilities

  • Support and execute transformational domestic and cross-border mergers, acquisitions, GP stakes transactions, minority investments, spin-outs, and strategic partnerships across traditional and alternative asset managers (7%).
  • Represent corporate clients, private equity funds, and institutional investors in reorganizations, carve-outs, joint ventures, and strategic equity investments involving asset managers and fund platforms (7%).
  • Advise on regulatory compliance throughout the transaction lifecycle under frameworks including the Investment Advisers Act, Investment Company Act, Securities Act, Exchange Act, Dodd-Frank, Volcker Rule, ERISA, SEC Marketing Rule, FINRA broker-dealer rules, AIFMD, and foreign jurisdiction equivalents (3%).
  • Demonstrate fluency in fund structures (mutual funds, ETFs, private funds, SMAs) and investment strategies (credit, real estate, hedge, private equity), with proven ability to synthesize legal, commercial, and operational considerations into business-oriented solutions (5%).
  • Draft corporate documents required for company organization or for adoption of changes to companies, including documents for entity formation, governance changes, transformations, and liquidations, powers of attorney, resolutions of general meetings, waivers of appeal, and motions for Commercial Register and other authorities (e.g. powers of attorney, statements, decisions, draft agreements); draft motions for entry of changes in entries of companies in Commercial Register (e.g. change of business name, registered office, statutory body, etc.), and complete schedules to such motions (4%).
  • Draft legal memoranda and commentary on commercial and corporate law issues, including precedent analysis, regulatory interpretation in the U.S. and foreign jurisdictions, and strategic alternatives such as GP-led secondaries, IPOs, succession planning, and minority stake sales (3%).

title: Service Reporting & Insights Lead
description:
Description
  • Lead reporting, analytics and insights capability across Service & Experience
  • Turn complex data into meaningful stories, decisions and action
  • Partner with leaders to shape performance, workforce and member outcomes

About US
UniSuper is a place where brilliant thinkers and passionate people come together. As one of Australia’s largest super funds, the work you’ll do with us makes a meaningful difference today and tomorrow for our members, the planet and for you.

Our Service & Experience division is recognised for performance excellence and for shaping the future of retirement for our members every day. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for you to challenge yourself, develop new skills, and make a real impact. Within this role your ideas are valued, your ambition is celebrated and your work genuinely matters.

The Role
If you're passionate about turning complex data into meaningful insights and helping leaders make better decisions, this is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how information is used across one of Australia's leading super funds.

As our Service Reporting & Insights Lead, you'll be the reporting, analytics and insights specialist within the Service & Experience division. Working at the intersection of data, operational performance and workforce intelligence, you'll help transform information into clear, actionable insights that support better business outcomes.

You'll partner closely with leaders across Service & Experience to understand the questions they're trying to answer, translate business needs into reporting and analytics solutions, and develop meaningful insights that help drive action.

This is an opportunity to influence how reporting, business intelligence and workforce insights are used across the division, while helping improve service performance, operational efficiency and member outcomes.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the development, delivery and ongoing improvement of reporting, analytics and insight products across Service & Experience.
  • Turn complex data into meaningful insights, recommendations and narratives that support decision making.
  • Design and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance measures that provide clear visibility of operational performance.
  • Work closely with leaders to understand business questions and translate them into reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes through analysis of operational, workforce and service data.
  • Partner with the Data Office and enterprise stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting capability and self-service solutions.
  • Establish reporting standards, governance practices and continuous improvement initiatives across the function.
  • Coach and support team members in reporting, analytics and insight practices.

About You
You are naturally curious and enjoy finding the story behind the numbers.

You're at your best when helping others make sense of complex information, connecting data from multiple sources and translating it into clear insights, recommendations and action.

You understand that great reporting isn't just about producing dashboards. It's about helping people understand what is happening, why it's happening and what they should do next.

You enjoy working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and are comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader business conversations.

Whether you're developing a reporting solution, identifying an emerging trend or presenting insights to leaders, you're able to communicate complex information in a simple and meaningful way.

You will bring:

  • Strong experience in reporting, analytics, business intelligence, workforce intelligence or insights roles within a complex operational environment.
  • Exceptional capability in translating business requirements into reporting, analytics or data solutions that deliver meaningful insights, recommendations and business outcomes.
  • Advanced level in Data Modelling – developing models to represent and communicate data requirements and data assets.
  • Intermediate to Advanced experience in a variety of insights related tools and techniques including SQL Server / SSRS / SSIS / SSAS; Power BI; Python and Azure Databricks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to identify trends, drivers and improvement opportunities.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions.
  • Experience working with large or complex datasets and partnering with technical teams to improve reporting outcomes.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and a passion for helping organisations become more data-informed.
  • Most importantly, you'll be someone who can take complex information and turn it into insights that help leaders make confident decisions.

What US offer
We believe that the best way to achieve great things is when we come together and collaborate. Therefore, we ask you to be able to commit to 60% of your time in office.

UniSuper’s high performance culture is supported by a range of benefits that demonstrates our commitment to ensuring our employees achieve their full potential, thrive, and grow their career with us. These include:

  • A personal development budget of $1500 to support employees in their professional growth
  • Community, Culture & Wellbeing leave
  • Mental physical and financial well-being initiatives

At UniSuper, we value and celebrate diversity and inclusion in our workplace, where everybody can thrive. We believe that having a variety of perspectives, backgrounds, interests, abilities, and skills is crucial for delivering great retirement outcomes for our members. We invite you to apply for the roles that suit your career aspirations, even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed.

Think Great. Create Great.

title: Coordinator, Engagement & Development
description:
NA

At White & Case, our longstanding dedication to fairness, belonging and professional growth comes to life through our Engagement & Development function. It reflects our commitment to fostering a global workplace culture where our people feel connected, supported and empowered to develop meaningful careers. Led by our Chief Engagement & Development Officer and guided by our Partner-led Engagement & Development Committee, this function ensures coordinated, impactful and accessible programming Firmwide — strengthening performance, enhancing leadership capabilities and reinforcing our shared sense of community.

Role Overview

This temporary Consultant role provides operational support to the E&D Operations team, with a particular focus on three priority projects: the rollout of the new LMS (Workday Learning), the development of new budget and expenditure review processes, the centralization and merging of documents and processes for the combined E&D functions, as well a support for mandatory and compliance training.

The role will assist with project planning and basic budget coordination for E&D, including supporting annual budget preparation, helping to compile and review monthly expenditure reports and coordinating routine interactions with Finance on budget and expenditure processes. The role involves close collaboration within the E&D team, Engagement and L&D colleagues, global and regional committees and other internal stakeholders. It requires clear, practical communication with diverse audiences and effective use of technology and document management to support process improvements and ensure E&D activities are delivered efficiently and consistently during this transition period.

Our Team

The Engagement & Development Team is responsible for:

  • The professional skills curriculum for lawyers and Business Services professionals

  • Mandatory and regulatory compliance training

  • The Firm’s Coaching Office and global mentoring initiatives

  • Lawyer and Business Services professional participation in committees and Firmwide initiatives

  • Engagement surveys (e.g. People’s Voice) and other listening mechanisms

  • Recognition programs

  • Induction and exit strategies

  • Global Affinity Networks, which are open to people of all backgrounds

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support E&D Operations with annual budget processes, including consolidating budget inputs and helping prepare monthly expenditure reports for review, highlighting key variances and issues.

  • Support E&D Operations with annual budget processes during the transition period, including consolidating budget inputs and assisting with the preparation of monthly expenditure reports for review, highlighting key variances and issues as directed.

  • Maintain E&D organizational documentation, including org charts and role descriptions, ensuring files are accurate, updated and stored in a central, easily accessible location to support the merging of Engagement and L&D materials.

  • Coordinate and maintain the central filing system for the E&D team via iManage, applying agreed structures and practices to support effective information management and the centralization of documents across the combined functions.

  • Support the development and implementation of improvements to E&D processes, tools and ways of working by following updated procedures related to the merger and sharing practical suggestions for streamlining tasks and documentation.

  • Use available technology and data tools, including Workday Learning and iManage, to help simplify workflows, improve reporting quality and support efficient delivery of E&D and Engagement activities during the six-month workload increase.

  • Provide coordination support to the Firm’s affinity groups and women’s networks, including assisting with professional development activities, tracking follow-up actions and preparing tailored communications under guidance from relevant leads.

  • Assist with planning and logistics for periodic events and programs across offices for Global Engagement Initiatives, including internal and client-facing speaker series, ensuring arrangements are in place and aligned with event requirements.

  • Provide administrative support for sponsorships of professional conferences and events linked to Global Engagement Initiatives, including attendee outreach and registration, invoice processing and coordination with Marketing on materials.

  • Help with the administration of compliance and mandatory training programs in Workday Learning as part of the LMS rollout, including course setup, scheduling, enrollment and tracking completion for participants.

  • Monitor completion of Compliance training programs in Workday Learning, ensuring accurate records of attendance and certification status and following up on outstanding completions as directed by the Engagement and L&D teams.

  • Support the development, deployment and user acceptance testing (UAT) of eLearning modules in Workday Learning by uploading content, checking accessibility and confirming alignment with organizational requirements, specifically for third-party courses from SkillBurst and VinciWorks.

  • Coordinate logistics with internal stakeholders — including Events, office reception and concierge, HROD L&D, audio-visual, technology, catering, facilities and travel agency teams — to support the delivery and rollout of Compliance training programs.

  • Assist with the production of program materials, management of digital resources and tracking of budgets and expenses for training programs, including processing vendor invoices and maintaining documentation for key external vendor relationships.

  • Maintain and update iManage workspaces, Connect intranet pages (where applicable), ServiceNow knowledge articles and Firm calendars to ensure program and event records, trackers and merged documentation remain current.

  • Monitor ServiceNow cases related to training and LMS rollout, escalating queries as appropriate and helping ensure timely resolution during the transition period.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated interest in talent engagement, professional development and affinity or diversity initiatives in the workplace, with a strong client service mindset.

  • Clear and confident communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to provide accurate information and updates to different audiences and work effectively with colleagues at various levels.

  • Ability to deliver reliable, high-quality work under pressure, with strong time management, organizational and task management skills and close attention to detail when handling multiple priorities and tight deadlines.

  • Experience working collaboratively in a professional services or similar fast-paced environment, with an inclusive, culturally sensitive and team-oriented approach to building strong working relationships.

  • Good awareness of business and operational needs, with the ability to understand Firm priorities and apply this insight when supporting E&D, engagement and training activities.

  • Strong Excel skills and good proficiency in Word, PowerPoint and core systems such as LMS platforms (e.g. Workday Learning), iManage, intranet and basic CRM or database applications to support reporting, documentation and information management.

  • Proven ability to use technology and systems to streamline administrative tasks, maintain accurate records and support efficient processes, particularly in relation to data management, document filing and training coordination.

  • Proactive and resourceful, able to work on own initiative within clear guidelines, with a willingness to contribute practical suggestions for improving processes and ways of working during the transition period.

  • Experience supporting project coordination and logistics, including events, training programs or similar initiatives, ideally within a legal or professional services organization.

  • Degree-level education or equivalent experience, with at least two years’ experience in an administrative or coordination role in a complex, fast-paced setting.

  • Flexible, committed and enthusiastic, with the ability to work occasional evenings and weekends where needed to support global events, training rollouts and time zones.

Location and Reporting

  • This position is based in the Firm’s London office.

  • Our standard office hours are 09:30-18:00, with a requirement for 4 days (Monday to Thursday) in the office per week.

  • This role reports to the Advisor, Engagement and Development (Global) with an indirect reporting line to the Associate Director, Engagement and Development (Global).

What We Offer

When you join us, you’ll be working directly with partners, business leaders and many other inspiring colleagues across our global network of offices. We live by our values—to be pioneering, united and human—and we believe that you’ll experience them from your first day. We will give you the support and development opportunities that will help you achieve your potential. We believe that consistent high performance merits reward and support. Our compensation package reflects your calibre as a business development professional, and our benefits are designed to support your changing needs and priorities across different life stages.

Firm Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension plan with matched employer contribution up to 7.5%

  • Yearly wellbeing fund

  • Income protection

  • Holiday purchase

  • Life insurance

  • Critical Illness insurance

  • Private GP services

  • Travel insurance

  • Dental coverage

  • Cycle to work

  • Holiday purchase (available during annual enrolment)

Associate Director, Engagement & Development

It is our Firm’s policy to recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, religion, creed, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected by applicable law.

If you require assistance and/or adjustment to participate in our application and/or interview process, please email us. We will be happy to work with you.

title: Entry Level Associate Neurophysiologist (Traverse City, MI)
description:
NuVasive Clinical Services, a subsidiary of Globus Medical Inc., is a leading provider of intraoperative neuromonitoring (IOM) services to surgeons and healthcare facilities. IOM technology gives those in the operating room real-time insight into the nervous system, which can help surgeons reduce surgical risk by providing critical information and alerts throughout the procedure.

Entry level may apply! Full training provided!

Position Summary:

As a Neurophysiologist at NuVasive Clinical Services, you’ll provide intraoperative neuromonitoring during surgery by monitoring the patient’s nervous system. A high standard of patient care is essential to our team. This is a great opportunity for you to work with our top surgeons and other medical professionals in a team environment and play a vital role in the operating room every day. As a member of our team, you will also support NuVasive technological innovations. NuVasive provides comprehensive training, continuing education, and numerous opportunities for career development. Please note this is a field-based role.

Essential Functions:

  • Obtains a detailed medical history on the patient and consults with the surgeon regarding patient structures at risk and modalities to be monitored
  • Communicates monitoring information to the surgeon and the surgical team throughout the case
  • Displays and labels waveforms for marking, measuring and calculating information such as latencies, amplitudes and conduction times following established guidelines and protocols
  • Identifies appropriate protocols and performs troubleshooting techniques to assure accurate data collection
  • Completes all required documentation and accurately prepares all IOM logs, files, and timely file uploads
  • Maintains all neuromonitoring equipment and conduct required maintenance checks
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Adheres to the letter and spirit of the company Code of Conduct, the AdvaMed Code, MedTech Code, and all other company policies
  • Ensures Compliance with applicable governmental laws, rules, and regulations, both in the United States and internationally, by completing introductory and annual training and maintaining knowledge of compliance as it applies to your role
  • Represents the company in a professional manner and uphold the highest standards of ethical business practices and socially responsible conduct in all interactions with other employees, customers, suppliers, and other third parties

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Qualifications:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience
  • Certified in Neurophysiologic Intraoperative Monitoring (CNIM)
  • Knowledge of Intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring (IONM) and/or human anatomy & physiology and/or technical troubleshooting preferred
  • Operating Room (OR) experience preferred
  • Strong time management & organizational skills, and ability to manage competing demands, frequent change, delays and/or unexpected events in scheduling and in the operating room on a daily basis
  • Effective communication skills and proven ability to collaborate in a team-oriented setting including communication in English with surgeons and surgical staff
  • Ability to handle the demands of regular travel
  • Be qualified for and maintain privileges at all required hospitals, including meeting any applicable physical requirements or vaccination requirements (including COVID-19 vaccine, as applicable)
  • Be eligible for medical malpractice insurance coverage at standard rates, which insurance shall be provided by the Company
  • Maintain the CNIM status

Travel and/or Physical Demands:

  • Able to travel up to 25%
  • Ability to transport and set up equipment totaling 50lbs in a timely fashion in the operating room including IONM system, laptop, and supplies
  • Ability to bend over to perform certain duties, stand for several periods of time, visual and auditory skills, manual dexterity, wear gloves, masks, gowns, and goggles for extended periods of time
  • Requires a valid driver's license and transportation with the ability to transport medical equipment in the country of operation

Our Life Moves Us philosophy is built on four values: Passionate About Innovation, Customer Focused, Teamwork, and Driven.

  • Passionate about Innovation: Improving patient care by delivering advanced technology to our customers is at the core of what we do. We are passionate ab our role in improving the lives of patients by continuously developing better solutions.

title: Senior Fraud Analyst - On site - Yuba City, CA
description:
Summary

The Senior Fraud Analyst supports the Credit Union’s digital fraud prevention program by monitoring, investigating, analyzing, and escalating fraud activity across digital channels. This role is responsible for reviewing alerts, identifying suspicious patterns, conducting complex investigations, and supporting loss-mitigation efforts related to online banking, mobile banking, digital account opening, remote deposit capture, card-not-present activity, digital payments, and real-time transaction-monitoring platforms.


The Senior Fraud Analyst serves as a subject matter resource in digital fraud trends, identity intelligence, fraud-risk controls, and investigative best practices. This position works closely with business units, IT, Cybersecurity, Virtual/Digital Banking, Lending, Member Services, Payments, and BSA/AML to help maintain a strong fraud-prevention posture while supporting a positive member experience.


This role requires strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, sound decision-making, and the ability to manage complex fraud matters in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Functions

  1. Monitor and investigate digital channel fraud alerts, including activity related to online banking, mobile banking, digital account opening, remote deposit capture, digital payments, card-not-present transactions, and real-time transaction-monitoring systems.
  2. Review, analyze, and disposition alerts and cases in a timely and accurate manner, ensuring appropriate documentation within the Case Management System.
  3. Conduct complex digital fraud investigations involving account takeover, synthetic identity fraud, credential stuffing, bot activity, phishing, mule activity, remote deposit fraud, digital payment fraud, and other emerging fraud trends.
  4. Identify suspicious patterns, anomalies, fraud rings, behavioral indicators, and high-risk activity across digital channels.
  5. Take appropriate loss-mitigation steps, including account restrictions, member outreach, transaction review, escalation, and coordination with internal departments as needed.
  6. Serve as a subject matter resource for digital fraud matters and provide guidance to internal teams regarding fraud trends, red flags, investigative findings, and recommended next steps.
  7. Support the configuration, testing, tuning, and ongoing review of fraud detection tools, rules engines, alert logic, behavioral analytics, identity verification tools, and digital risk platforms.
  8. Assist with reviewing fraud model performance, alert effectiveness, false positive trends, and opportunities to improve detection accuracy and operational efficiency.
  9. Maintain working knowledge of AI/ML-driven fraud detection platforms, behavioral biometric tools, device fingerprinting systems, identity verification solutions, digital risk signals, data enrichment tools, and case management workflows.
  10. Participate in testing and implementation efforts related to new fraud prevention tools, digital channel controls, system enhancements, and process improvements.
  11. Collaborate with Virtual/Digital Banking, Member Services, Lending, IT, Cybersecurity, Payments, Compliance, and BSA/AML during fraud investigations, escalations, and digital fraud events.
  12. Support incident response efforts related to digital channel fraud by gathering documentation, summarizing findings, identifying member impact, and assisting with post-incident review.
  13. Coordinate with vendors and internal partners regarding system issues, detection concerns, case handling, platform performance, or fraud prevention enhancements.
  14. Ensure investigations and related actions comply with applicable regulatory requirements, including BSA/AML, KYC/CIP, OFAC, Regulation E, Regulation Z, privacy requirements, and internal policies and procedures.
  15. Prepare reports, summaries, and trend information related to alert volumes, case activity, losses, recoveries, emerging fraud schemes, and digital fraud risk indicators.
  16. Assist with maintaining and updating fraud procedures, job aids, investigative guidelines, training materials, and digital fraud prevention resources.
  17. Support audit, exam, fraud risk assessment, and compliance-related requests by providing accurate data, documentation, and investigative support.
  18. Identify opportunities to strengthen fraud controls, improve investigative processes, reduce losses, and enhance the member experience.
  19. Maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive member, employee, account, and fraud-related information.
  20. Perform additional duties as assigned.

title: Associate Director, New Product Commercialization
description:
Why Sarepta? Why Now?

The promise of genetic medicine has arrived, and Sarepta is at the forefront. We hold a leadership position in Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Duchenne) and are building a robust portfolio of programs across muscle, central nervous system, and cardiac diseases. In 2023, we launched our fourth therapy and the first ever gene therapy to treat Duchenne.

We’re looking for people who see unlimited potential in themselves and who are motivated by an unwavering commitment to patients.

What Sarepta Offers

At Sarepta, we care deeply about all the people in our community and believe in the importance of supporting them in all aspects of their lives. We aspire to maintain a culture that acknowledges people bring their whole selves to work, and we will strive to help everyone in our community integrate their work and personal lives while maintaining productivity. We are committed to offering a range of benefits and work-life resources designed to support people in the following areas:

  • Physical and Emotional Wellness

  • ​Financial Wellness

  • Support for Caregivers

For a full list of our comprehensive benefits, see our website:

The Importance of the Role

The Associate Director, New Product Commercialization is responsible for supporting the development of early commercial strategy and conducting opportunity assessments and competitive analysis to support emerging precision genetic therapies and technologies. The AD leads analyses to provide key commercial insights on projects from target identification and discovery through clinical proof-of-concept. This role also leads engagements with Business Development to provide commercial assessments of external opportunities and will serve as the commercial lead on select program teams. Working closely with Research, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Business Development, Medical Affairs and Commercial functions, as well as external vendors, the AD contributes to the early strategic analysis and approach to Sarepta programs and is responsible for presenting findings broadly across the organization, including to senior management.

The Opportunity to Make a Difference

  • Lead collaborative work to develop and refine market assessments to gain a deep understanding of the disease, the patient, how they are being treated today and the unmet need
  • Lead competitive intelligence efforts, including continuous assessment of the R&D landscape and synthesis of competitor insights to inform program and portfolio strategy
  • Lead the development of the target product profile with a cross functional team and validate the commercial potential of our profile through a rigorous study of key external stakeholders’ perspectives on the opportunity
  • Serve as the commercial representative on select program teams, shaping program strategy and ensuring commercial considerations are embedded in key development decisions
  • Translate key insights from scientific experts (internal R&D colleagues and external opinion leaders) into clear, actionable strategies for the asset
  • Understand and communicate requirements for reimbursement, genetic diagnosis and differentiation required for the successful commercialization of new Sarepta products
  • Engage key external stakeholders, including key opinion leaders, prescribing physicians, patients and payers and incorporate their perspectives into the program development plan
  • Partner with Commercial Operations and Manufacturing to develop integrated forecasts
  • Provide support to opportunity assessments to inform Business Development opportunities, target selection and pipeline investment decisions
  • Collaborate with Research to identify new genetic targets for application of each of Sarepta’s platform technologies
  • Manage project budgets and external vendors supporting market research and strategic analyses, ensuring efficient allocation of resources across priorities
  • Other related duties as required

More about You

  • BA/BS degree in a related field; 10+ years of related experience; MBA preferred with 8+ years of related experience
  • Prior biotech/pharma strategic roles, with a track record of accountability, urgency, and cross-functional leadership
  • Experience evaluating commercial opportunities for therapies targeting rare/ultra-rare diseases
  • Experience representing the commercial function on program teams
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to synthesize complex, disparate information
  • Proven ability to leverage deep customer and market insights to inform R&D decisions and develop patient- and physician-centric strategies
  • Experience leading or contributing to competitive intelligence (CI) efforts, including landscape assessments and synthesis of competitor insights to inform strategic decision-making
  • Experience managing project budgets and external vendors, with ability to prioritize resources effectively across multiple initiatives
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across multiple functions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment

What Now?

We’re always looking for solution-oriented, critical thinkers.

So, if you’re comfortable with ambiguity and candor, relish challenging yourself, and place kindness and integrity at the forefront of how you approach your peers and work, then we encourage you to apply.

Sarepta is making a good faith effort to be transparent and accurate around our hiring ranges. The salary offer is commensurate with Sarepta’s compensation philosophy and considers factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, external market conditions, criticality of role, and internal equity.Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S.Sarepta Therapeutics offers a competitive compensation and benefit package.Sarepta Therapeutics is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and participates in e-Verify.

title: collision body tech
description:
Hendrick Collision Center Hwy 55 DurhamLocation: 5403 NC Hwy 55, Durham, North Carolina 27713


Summary: Responsible for identifying and performing necessary body repair work in accordance with factory and Collision Center specifications.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no direct supervisor responsibilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Examines body damage on customer vehicles
  • Identifies necessary body repair work
  • Estimates cost of body work
  • Requests necessary parts
  • Performs body repairs including removing damaged body parts and replacing with fixed or new parts
  • Documents repairs performed
  • Performs body repairs efficiently and according to Collision Center and insurance company guidelines
  • Maintains CSI at or above Company standards
  • Maintains an organized, clean and safe work area
  • Participates in required training
  • Records all hours worked accurately in company timekeeping system
  • Follows Safeguards rules and regulations.
  • Demonstrates the Company’s Core Values.
  • Complies with Company policies and procedures.
  • Observes all Federal, State, Local and Company safety rules and regulations in the performance of duties.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with medical conditions to perform the essential functions.

Desired Education: High School Diploma

Desired Work Experience: 5+ years

Certificates and Licenses: Driver’s License

Education/Experience:

Thorough knowledge of automotive parts and systems. Demonstrable mechanical skills and knowledge. Technical training or commensurate technical experience required.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions. Ability to deal with standardized situations. Ability to understand and follow technical manuals. Strong problem-solving skills to identify and request necessary parts, and perform repairs efficiently while adhering to dealership and manufacturer guidelines.

Verbal and Writing Ability:

Ability to read and comprehend instructions, correspondence, and memos. Ability to use communication skills to clearly explain vehicle issues, repair needs, and recommendations to team members, service advisors, and customers. Proficient writing skills to accurately document services performed, parts requested, and any issues identified, ensuring clear and thorough records in the dealership's system.

Computer Skills:

Proficient in using dealership software systems to document vehicle services, track repair history, and manage timekeeping. Capable of navigating the parts department inventory and ordering system to request necessary parts efficiently, and able to utilize technology to ensure accurate documentation of repairs and maintenance.

Math Ability:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide. Proficiency in using measurements to assess parts and ensure proper fitting during repairs and maintenance.

Environment Demands:

Duties are performed primarily in the service area. Work includes movement around vehicles, working in various physical positions, and the safe operation of power tools and test equipment. May be exposed to loud noise, vibration, exhaust fumes, and other service and repair conditions. Frequently interacts with customers, service advisors and the service manager.

Communication Skills:

Ability to clearly communicate with customers and team members to accurately diagnose issues, explain repair needs, and provide updates on vehicle status. Must be able to follow detailed service instructions and relay any necessary information about repairs, maintenance, or parts requirements to ensure efficient workflow and customer satisfaction.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

  • Standing & Movement: Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday on hard surfaces such as concrete; frequently bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl to access vehicle undercarriages, wheel wells, and low-clearance areas
  • Reaching & Working Positions: Reach overhead, below the knee, and at shoulder level; work in confined spaces, awkward positions, and at various heights when accessing different vehicle areas
  • Hand & Wrist Use: Continuously use hands and fingers to grip, handle, feel, and manipulate tools, equipment, spray guns, and vehicle components; perform repetitive hand and wrist motions throughout the shift
  • Vision: Maintain close, distance, color, depth perception, and peripheral vision to accurately assess vehicle damage, match paint colors, and ensure quality of repairs
  • Sensory: Must be able to talk and hear, including wearing hearing protection as required; ability to detect odors related to chemicals, paints, and vehicle fluids
  • Physical Stamina: Sustain physical activity throughout an entire shift, which may include extended hours; safely work in a fast-paced environment with exposure to noise, fumes, and varying temperature

Core Values:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following Core Values:

Servant Leadership

Servant Leaders consciously put the needs of others before their own, because to serve people is to value them.

Diversity is strength, and when we trust and respect one another we can work as a team to achieve at a high level.

Being honest and transparent with people, in an effort to do the right thing within the letter and spirit of the law, drives every action we take and every decision we make.

Every day we recommit ourselves to the customer experience, and we are empowered to exceed the expectations of our customers.

Passion for Winning

Hendrick’s tradition of winning is based on the idea of striving to be the best, not the biggest, and is therefore defined by how we treat our people.

Accountability at All Levels

Taking ownership of our actions and our decisions allows us to grow as individuals, and support each other as a team.

Commitment to Continuous Improvement

Every day we soften our hearts as well as our egos, in order to seek out and improve upon areas of opportunity within ourselves and our team.

The employee will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties and responsibilities upon the request of a supervisor. title: Principal Product Architect (Edina)
description:
At BI WORLDWIDE, we are committed to creating belongingness, where D\&I is a priority. We invite you to join us as we continue to expand our culture of inclusivity, collaboration, and authenticity together.

We work a hybrid model (3 days in the office and 2 days work from home); this position is located in our Minneapolis Metro headquarters.

Our Corporate Product Development Group is seeking interest for a Principal Product Architect.

We are looking for a senior technical leader to serve as the primary architectural voice for our customer-facing platform. This person will set technical direction, establish standards, and work across teams to ensure our platform remains scalable, secure, and maintainable as the business grows.

This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports. Authority in this role comes from technical credibility, not org chart position.

Responsibilities
  • Evaluate long-term business needs and translate them into architectural direction / decisions.
  • Lead architecture decision-making across the platform (3 architects), including documenting decisions and trade-offs.
  • Define and maintain platform-wide architectural standards -- covering scalability, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
  • Work with product owners to define and design solutions to business problems.
  • Partner with DevOps and infrastructure teams to keep application and infrastructure strategy in sync.
  • Mentor development leads and architects across the organization. This role has no direct reports; influence is through expertise and relationship, not management.
  • Own the security architecture and compliance for the platform -- ensuring systems are built and maintained to industry and BIW security standards.
  • Work across product teams including product owners, engineering managers, developers, QA, UX, and leadership.
  • Be an escalation point to lead incident response on critical issues if/when needed.
  • Set the technical strategy for AI within the platform -- including partnering with product owners on where AI features add product value, introduce risk, and how they should be governed.
  • Champion the responsible use of AI tools to improve engineering and team productivity.
  • Stay current on relevant technology trends to set product technical strategy.
Role Scope

Most of the work in this role is strategic: setting direction, making architectural decisions, working with stakeholders, and keeping teams aligned. You will spend most of your time in design sessions, reviews, roadmap conversations, and cross-team technical discussions -- not writing production code. That said, the role requires genuine technical depth. You need to be able to read code, give real feedback in design and review sessions, and hold your own with senior engineers.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who spent a real portion of their career as an engineer before moving into architecture. We need someone whose technical judgment comes from having built and shipped software, not from a management track or a consulting background. You do not need to be heads-down in code today, but the foundation has to be there.

Distributed systems and architecture knowledge
  • Experience designing and governing cloud-native, microservices-based platforms.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems patterns: service decomposition, event-driven architecture, API design, data consistency, and failure handling.
  • Experience with cloud-native infrastructure. Our platform runs on AWS with Kubernetes and Kafka at the core; general cloud experience is what matters -- deep AWS specialization is not required.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining architectural standards across multiple teams, including documenting decisions and trade-offs.
  • Ability to reason clearly about quality attributes -- scalability, reliability, security, observability, maintainability -- and make trade-offs between them explicit.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical designs.
AI strategy and adoption
  • Experience implementing AI-driven product features (e.g., generative AI, recommendations, automation) in a production SaaS platform, and using AI tools to boost personal and team productivity.
  • Ability to evaluate AI capabilities pragmatically -- distinguishing genuine product value from hype, and making build-vs-buy calls on AI vendors and models.
  • Understanding of the trade-ops specific to AI systems: cost, latency, data privacy, model reliability, and vendor lock-in.
  • Ability to establish guardrails for responsible AI use, including data governance, security, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Awareness of how AI coding and productivity tools are changing engineering workflows, and how to help teams adopt them effectively.
Respect for an existing platform Communication and leadership
  • Able to communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.
  • Able to mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across teams without management authority.
  • Deep experience with agile development practices.
Security and platform health

Responsible for ensuring the platform is:

  • Secure -- built and maintained to industry and BIW security standards.
  • Observable -- instrumented with logging, tracing, and monitoring sufficient for proactive operation.

Base Salary Range: $180,000.00 to $220,000.00. The final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant's background, experience, and skills.

Warner Music’s Global Service Center Revenue Team collects and consolidates revenue for the company and works with other service center teams to provide best-in-class services to our global Finance labels and affiliates.

  • Familiarity with reporting tools such as Business Objects or similar

  • A passion for music and an interest in how the business side of the industry works

Torch Technologies is seeking a Junior Test Engineer (Electrical/Automated Test Systems) to join our team and support reverse engineering and test development for Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) used on weapons platforms. This role focuses on analyzing electronic hardware, developing test strategies, and supporting validation and sustainment of fielded systems through hands-on testing and automation.

  • Integrate COTS instrumentation including PXI/PXIe modules, switching systems, programmable power supplies, and measurement equipment

  • Assist in development and execution of test sequences using automated test frameworks

  • Perform fault isolation and troubleshooting of electronic assemblies during testing activities

  • Document test procedures, results, and engineering findings to support sustainment and technical data packages

  • Support hardware/software integration, debugging, and validation within lab environments

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, and systems engineers to ensure accurate test coverage and system integration

title: Premium Auditor Specialist
description:
We’re excited you’re considering joining a great place to work!

Texas Mutual is deeply committed to creating and maintaining an environment of mutual respect and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.


About this Position

At Texas Mutual, we are proud to create a stronger, safer Texas. That means helping injured workers return to a productive life, empowering businesses to excel, and giving back to our communities. As a Premium Audit Specialist, you will provide exceptional service to our valued policyholders. This service will achieve its goals through our analysis of financial records, our evaluation of operations, and our review of workers' compensation class codes. Additionally, you will conduct onsite final audits to determine true exposure and premium earned.

This Texas-based field position reports to our Austin regional office and primarily serves the Rio Grande Valley and San Antonio markets, among other areas as needed. Candidates must reside in either the Rio Grande Valley or San Antonio area.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Conduct Professional Employer Organization final audits and other large complex accounts.

  • Apply the NCCI and Texas Basic Manual Rules, Classifications, and Rates for Workers' Compensation on accounts.

  • Provide advanced premium audit expertise, technical assistance, and education to staff, management, policyholders, and agents.

  • Recommend, develop, and document premium audit procedures.

  • Notify Special Investigation Department of accounts that are suspected of fraudulent practices, including participating in premium fraud investigations, estimating premium losses, providing depositions, and expert testimony in litigation.

It is required that you:

  • Have a bachelor's degree or equivalent education, training, or experience.

  • Have at least four years of premium audit experience or equivalent education, training and experience.

  • Have extensive knowledge of underwriting principles, the TDI/NCCI basic manual of rules and Texas labor, and multistate workers' compensation auditing rules and regulations.

  • Can travel in state as needed to visit our policyholders.

It would be great to also have:
CPCU or Associate in Premium Audit designation

Texas Mutual Pay Transparency

Individual base pay within the range is determined by a variety of factors, including experience, performance, education, and demonstration of skills and competencies required for each role. Your recruiter can discuss the full value of our total compensation package with you, including our generous bonus plans and flex-hybrid work model.

Base Pay Range: $49.27 - $60.87 Per Hour

Flex-Hybrid Work Environment:

Texas Mutual’s flex-hybrid schedule allows you to bring your best self to work by working remotely and collaborating in the office based on business needs. All Texas Mutual employees are required to have Texas residency and travel to their designated office as needed.

Our Benefits:

  • Student loan repayment matching in 401k plan

title: Associate Member Service Officer
description:
If you are motivated and believe in the credit union philosophy of "People Helping People," join our team!

Purpose
The Associate Member Services Officer (MSO) is an entry-level position intended to provide team members with foundational knowledge of SECU branch operations. Associate MSOs perform routine branch duties and follow standard branch procedures. They are responsible for providing exemplary member service by responding to member inquiries by telephone and in person, including functions such as cash box management, account origination and maintenance. Associate MSOs will also begin training in lending and collections at this level.


Performance Expectations and Essential Responsibilities
• Comply with all Credit Union policies and regulatory requirements.
• Ensure all member information remains confidential and members’ accounts are accessed for business purposes only.
• Security and control procedures must be followed by all branch employees.
• Attain basic knowledge of how to serve members with running and balancing a cash drawer in accordance with Performance Measurement Criteria standards.
• Adhere to SECU Check Acceptance Guidelines and Hold procedures.
• Greet and assist members in a courteous, professional, and timely manner through all service channels – in-person, phone, and digital communication.
• Answer phones and assist members with service requests.
• Obtain and execute Notary Public services as requested by management.
• Interact with other departments to facilitate member requests.
• Organize, file and scan documents daily.

• Process foreign and domestic wire transfers.
• Help order and return foreign currency.
• Troubleshoot problems with member accounts, cards, and on-line access including processing disputes.
• Review and take appropriate action on negative checking, NSFB, and Share Below $25 report.
• Begin learning to open basic accounts while following MIP procedures for existing members including share, money market, checking, and Share Term Certificates with experienced MSR/MSO supervision.
• Learn CXone and be able to assist MSS as requested.
• Begin obtaining basic knowledge of Financial Advisory and Real Estate products and services offered by SECU (i.e., insurance, retirement planning, investment services, trust, and mortgage services) and provide referrals as needed.
• Exhibit a positive attitude toward members and teammates while maintaining professional appearance and demeanor.
• Participate in additional training and continuing education to enhance knowledge of branch operations.
• Regular attendance and punctuality are mandatory.
• Complete additional tasks assigned by management and other administrative duties as needed.
• Learn safe deposit procedures and assist members with accessing their boxes with the assistance of an experienced MSR/MSO.
• Begin obtaining basic knowledge of all consumer lending and credit card products and services.
• Begin learning how to perform subsequent advances on existing open and home equity lines of credit.
• Contact members and document efforts regarding deposit and/or loan collection reports as directed by management. Collection Training class attendance is required prior to collecting loans.


Minimum Requirements
• Must have high school diploma or GED equivalent. Preferred – Bachelor’s degree, or CCUE Certification, or Associate of Arts degree or Associate of Science degree via the North Carolina Community College Transfer Program (NC-CTP).
• Consistently demonstrates SECU’s Core Values
• Must possess an aptitude for meeting people and developing member confidence, respect, and trust in the Credit Union.
• Must have good communication skills, both verbal and written.
• Must have good problem-solving skills.
• Must complete the Credit Unions Core Module Program within 12 months of hire date as a condition of employment.

Job Environment
Office setting with physical proximity to other employees and members. Some background noise from other employees, printers, telephone and coin machine.

Physical Demands
Must be able to comprehend and carry out job demands.
Job requires a substantial amount of sitting.
Use hands and fingers to press keys on a computer keyboard to enter or retrieve information.
Use hands and fingers to press telephone keypad and lift telephone receiver.
Must be able to comprehend phone calls.
Must be able to lift 10-15 pounds.

  • Develop detailed design drawings from general schematic and equipment drawings with the use of CAD software

Education

Work Experience

  • Skills in: NavisWorks software

Licenses and Certifications

  • Drafting Certification preferred

Strength Factor Rating - Physical Demands/Requirements

Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Strength Factor Description - Physical Demands/Requirements

  • Standing: Remaining on one's feet in an upright position at a work station without moving about (Occasionally)
  • Walking: Moving about on foot (Frequently)
  • Sitting: Remaining in a seated position (Constantly)
  • Lifting: Raising or lowering an object from one level to another (includes upward pulling) (Occasionally)
  • Carrying: Transporting an object, usually holding it in the hands or arms, or on the shoulder (Occasionally)
  • Pushing: Exerting force upon an object so that the object moves away from the force (Occasionally)
  • Pulling: Exerting force upon an object so that the object moves toward the force (includes jerking) (Occasionally)
  • Climbing: Ladders, Stairs (Occasionally)
  • Balancing: Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling (Occasionally)
  • Stooping: Bending the body downward and forward by bending the spine at the waist (Occasionally)
  • Kneeling: Bending the legs at the knees to come to rest on the knee or knees (Occasionally)
  • Crouching: Bending the body downward and forward by bending the legs and spine (Occasionally)
  • Crawling: Moving about on the hands and arms in any direction (Occasionally)
  • Reaching: Extending hands and arms in any direction (Constantly)
  • Handling: Seizing, holding, grasping, turning or otherwise working with the hand or hands (Manual Dexterity) (Constantly)
  • Fingering: Picking, pinching or otherwise working with the fingers primarily (Finger Dexterity) (Constantly)
  • Feeling: Perceiving such attributes of objects/materials as size, shape, temperature, texture, movement or pulsation by receptors in the skin, particularly those of the finger tips (Constantly)
  • Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas/information by means of the spoken word (Frequently)
  • Hearing: Perceiving the nature of sound by the ear (Frequently)
  • Tasting/Smelling: (Occasionally)
  • Near Vision: Clarity of vision at 20 inches or less (Constantly)
  • Far Vision: Clarity of vision at 20 feet for more (Frequently)
  • Depth Perception: Three-dimensional vision; ability to judge distances and spatial relationships so as to see objects where and as they actually are (Frequently)
  • Vision: Color - The ability to identify and distinguish colors (Constantly)

Working Conditions/Environment

Working Conditions

  • Well lighted, climate controlled areas (Constantly)
  • Frequent repetitive motion (Constantly)
  • CRT (Computer Monitor(s)) (Constantly)

Travel
